13	# TreeView
14	
15	A hierarchical, keyboard-navigable tree with expand/collapse and optional node selection.
16	Implements the ARIA tree widget pattern with `role="tree"`, `role="treeitem"`, and
17	`role="group"` for nested subtrees.
18	
19	## 1. State Machine
20	
21	### 1.1 States
22	
23	| State     | Description                               |
24	| --------- | ----------------------------------------- |
25	| `Idle`    | The tree does not have keyboard focus.    |
26	| `Focused` | The tree has keyboard focus on some node. |
27	
28	### 1.2 Events
29	
30	| Event                   | Payload | Description                                                  |
31	| ----------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
32	| `ExpandNode(String)`    | node ID | Expand a branch node.                                        |
33	| `CollapseNode(String)`  | node ID | Collapse a branch node.                                      |
34	| `ToggleNode(String)`    | node ID | Toggle expand/collapse of a branch.                          |
35	| `SelectNode(String)`    | node ID | Add a node to the selection.                                 |
36	| `DeselectNode(String)`  | node ID | Remove a node from the selection.                            |
37	| `FocusNode(String)`     | node ID | Move focus indicator to a node.                              |
38	| `FocusNext`             | —       | Move focus to the next visible node.                         |
39	| `FocusPrev`             | —       | Move focus to the previous visible node.                     |
40	| `FocusFirst`            | —       | Move focus to the first visible node.                        |
41	| `FocusLast`             | —       | Move focus to the last visible node.                         |
42	| `FocusParent`           | —       | Move focus to the parent of the focused node.                |
43	| `Focus { is_keyboard }` | `bool`  | The tree container received focus.                           |
44	| `Blur`                  | —       | The tree container lost focus.                               |
45	| `TypeaheadSearch(char)` | `char`  | Jump to the next node whose label starts with the character. |

57	/// Value type for TreeView collection items.
58	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
59	pub struct TreeItem {
60	    /// Display label for the node (used in typeahead and accessibility).
61	    pub label: String,
62	    /// Whether this node is disabled (not selectable, skipped during navigation).
63	    pub disabled: bool,
64	    /// When true, the node renders an expand affordance even if no children are
65	    /// present in the collection yet. Essential for lazy-loaded trees where the
66	    /// child count is unknown until the node is first expanded.
67	    pub has_children: bool,
68	    /// Optional navigation URL. When `Some`, the node renders as an `<a>` element
69	    /// instead of the default element, enabling native link behavior (middle-click
70	    /// to open in new tab, etc.). The `role="treeitem"` is preserved on the `<a>`.
71	    pub href: Option<String>,
72	}
73	
74	/// Context for the `TreeView` component.
75	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
76	pub struct Context {
77	    /// The tree collection — holds all nodes, parent-child relationships,
78	    /// and visible-key computation. See `06-collections.md §2.3`.
79	    pub items: TreeCollection<TreeItem>,
80	    /// Currently selected node IDs (uses canonical `selection::Set` from `ars_collections`).
81	    pub selected: Bindable<selection::Set>,
82	    /// Full selection state machine (mode, behavior, anchor, focus, disabled keys).
83	    pub selection_state: selection::State,
84	    /// Currently expanded branch node IDs (expansion ≠ selection).
85	    /// Uses `Bindable` for controlled/uncontrolled pattern.
86	    pub expanded: Bindable<BTreeSet<Key>>,

153	### 1.5 Full Machine Implementation
154	
155	```rust
156	use ars_core::{TransitionPlan, PendingEffect, Bindable, AttrMap};
157	
158	/// States for the `TreeView` component.
159	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
160	pub enum State {
161	    /// The tree view is in the idle state.
162	    Idle,
163	    /// The tree view is in the focused state.
164	    Focused,
165	}
166	
167	/// Events for the `TreeView` component.
168	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
169	pub enum Event {
170	    /// Expand a node.
171	    ExpandNode(String),
172	    /// Collapse a node.
173	    CollapseNode(String),
174	    /// Toggle the expand/collapse state of a node.
175	    ToggleNode(String),
176	    /// Select a node.
177	    SelectNode(String),
178	    /// Deselect a node.
179	    DeselectNode(String),
180	    /// Focus a node.
181	    FocusNode(String),
182	    /// Move focus to the next node.
183	    FocusNext,
184	    /// Move focus to the previous node.
185	    FocusPrev,
186	    /// Move focus to the first node.
187	    FocusFirst,
188	    /// Move focus to the last node.
189	    FocusLast,
190	    /// Move focus to the parent of the focused node.
191	    FocusParent,
192	    /// Focus the tree view.
193	    Focus {
194	        /// Whether the focus was initiated by a keyboard.
195	        is_keyboard: bool,
196	    },
197	    /// Blur the tree view.
198	    Blur,
199	    /// Typeahead search for a node.
200	    TypeaheadSearch(char),
201	    /// Expand all nodes in the tree.
202	    ExpandAll,
203	    /// Collapse all nodes in the tree.
204	    CollapseAll,
205	}
206	
207	/// Machine for the `TreeView` component.
208	pub struct Machine;
209	
210	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
211	    type State   = State;
212	    type Event   = Event;
213	    type Context = Context;
214	    type Props   = Props;
215	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
216	    type Messages = Messages;
217	
218	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
219	        let selected = match &props.selected {
220	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
221	            None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_selected.clone()),
222	        };
223	        let expanded = match &props.expanded {
224	            Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
225	            None    => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_expanded.clone()),
226	        };
227	        let selection_state = selection::State::new(
228	            props.selection_mode,
229	            props.selection_behavior,
230	        );
231	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
232	        let messages = messages.clone();
233	        let ids = ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id);
234	        (State::Idle, Context {
235	            items: props.items.clone(),
236	            selected,
237	            selection_state,
238	            expanded,
239	            focused_node: None,
240	            focus_visible: false,
241	            multiple: props.multiple,
242	            selection_mode: props.selection_mode,
243	            typeahead_buffer: String::new(),
244	            locale,
245	            messages,
246	            ids,
247	        })
248	    }
249	
250	    fn transition(
251	        state: &Self::State,
252	        event: &Self::Event,
253	        ctx: &Self::Context,
254	        _props: &Self::Props,
255	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
256	        match event {
257	
258	            Event::ExpandNode(id) => {
259	                let id = id.clone();
260	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
261	                    let mut exp = ctx.expanded.get().clone();
262	                    exp.insert(id);
263	                    ctx.expanded.set(exp);
264	                }))
265	            }
266	
267	            Event::CollapseNode(id) => {
268	                let id = id.clone();
269	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
270	                    let mut exp = ctx.expanded.get().clone();
271	                    exp.remove(&id);
272	                    ctx.expanded.set(exp);
273	                }))
274	            }
275	
276	            Event::ToggleNode(id) => {
277	                let is_expanded = ctx.expanded.get().contains(id.as_str());
278	                let id = id.clone();
279	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
280	                    let mut exp = ctx.expanded.get().clone();
281	                    if is_expanded {
282	                        exp.remove(&id);
283	                    } else {
284	                        exp.insert(id);
285	                    }
286	                    ctx.expanded.set(exp);
287	                }))
288	            }
289	
290	            Event::SelectNode(id) => {
291	                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None { return None; }
292	                let key = Key::from(id);
293	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
294	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.select(key);
295	                    ctx.selected.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
296	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
297	                }))
298	            }
299	
300	            Event::DeselectNode(id) => {
301	                let key = Key::from(id);
302	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
303	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.deselect(key);
304	                    ctx.selected.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
305	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
306	                }))
307	            }
308	
309	            Event::FocusNode(id) => {
310	                let id = id.clone();
311	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
312	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
313	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(id);
314	                    }))
315	            }
316	
317	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
318	                let is_keyboard = *is_keyboard;
319	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
320	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
321	                        ctx.focus_visible = is_keyboard;
322	                    }))
323	            }
324	
325	            Event::Blur => {
326	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
327	                    .apply(|ctx| {
328	                        ctx.focus_visible = false;
329	                    }))
330	            }
331	
332	            // ── Navigation (via TreeCollection API) ────────────────────────
333	            Event::FocusNext => {
334	                // Use TreeCollection::key_after() which respects expanded state
335	                // and skips structural nodes. Wraps to first node.
336	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
337	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
338	                let target = match &ctx.focused_node {
339	                    Some(current) => {
340	                        let pos = visible.iter().position(|k| k == current);
341	                        pos.and_then(|p| visible.get(p + 1).or_else(|| visible.first()))
342	                    }
343	                    None => visible.first(),
344	                };
345	                target.map(|key| {
346	                    let k = key.clone();
347	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
348	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
349	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
350	                    })
351	                })
352	            }
353	
354	            Event::FocusPrev => {
355	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
356	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
357	                let target = match &ctx.focused_node {
358	                    Some(current) => {
359	                        let pos = visible.iter().position(|k| k == current);
360	                        pos.and_then(|p| {
361	                            if p > 0 { visible.get(p - 1) }
362	                            else { visible.last() }
363	                        })
364	                    }
365	                    None => visible.last(),
366	                };
367	                target.map(|key| {
368	                    let k = key.clone();
369	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
370	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
371	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
372	                    })
373	                })
374	            }
375	
376	            Event::FocusFirst => {
377	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
378	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
379	                visible.first().map(|key| {
380	                    let k = key.clone();
381	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
382	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
383	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
384	                    })
385	                })
386	            }
387	
388	            Event::FocusLast => {
389	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
390	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
391	                visible.last().map(|key| {
392	                    let k = key.clone();
393	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
394	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
395	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
396	                    })
397	                })
398	            }
399	
400	            Event::FocusParent => {
401	                // Use Node::parent_key from the TreeCollection to navigate up
402	                let target = ctx.focused_node.as_ref()
403	                    .and_then(|focused| ctx.items.get(focused))
404	                    .and_then(|node| node.parent_key.clone());
405	                target.map(|key| {
406	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
407	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(key);
408	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
409	                    })
410	                })
411	            }
412	
413	            Event::TypeaheadSearch(ch) => {
414	                // Find the next visible node whose text_value starts with ch
415	                // (case-insensitive), starting after the focused node.
416	                let ch = ch.to_lowercase().next().unwrap_or(*ch);
417	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
418	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
419	                let start_pos = ctx.focused_node.as_ref()
420	                    .and_then(|f| visible.iter().position(|k| k == f))
421	                    .map(|p| p + 1)
422	                    .unwrap_or(0);
423	
424	                // Search from start_pos, wrapping around
425	                let target = visible.iter()
426	                    .cycle()
427	                    .skip(start_pos)
428	                    .take(visible.len())
429	                    .find(|key| {
430	                        ctx.items.get(key)
431	                            .and_then(|node| node.text_value.chars().next())
432	                            .map(|first| first.to_lowercase().next().unwrap_or(first) == ch)
433	                            .unwrap_or(false)
434	                    });
435	
436	                target.map(|key| {
437	                    let k = key.clone();
438	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
439	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
440	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
441	                    })
442	                })
443	            }
444	
445	            // ── Expand/Collapse All ────────────────────────────────────
446	            // ExpandAll — expand every expandable node
447	            Event::ExpandAll => {
448	                let expandable = ctx.items.nodes()
449	                    .filter(|n| n.has_children)
450	                    .map(|n| n.key.to_string())
451	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
452	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
453	                    let mut exp = ctx.expanded.get().clone();
454	                    for key in expandable {
455	                        exp.insert(key);
456	                    }
457	                    ctx.expanded.set(exp);
458	                }))
459	            }
460	
461	            // CollapseAll — collapse every node
462	            Event::CollapseAll => {
463	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
464	                    ctx.expanded.set(BTreeSet::new());
465	                }))
466	            }
467	
468	            _ => None,
469	        }
470	    }
471	
472	    fn connect<'a>(
473	        state: &'a Self::State,
474	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
475	        props: &'a Self::Props,
476	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
477	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
478	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
479	    }
480	}

484	
485	```rust
486	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
487	#[scope = "tree-view"]
488	pub enum Part {
489	    Root,
490	    Branch { node_id: String },
491	    BranchControl { node_id: String },
492	    BranchIndicator { node_id: String },
493	    BranchText,
494	    BranchContent { node_id: String },
495	    Leaf { node_id: String },
496	    LeafText,
497	}
498	
499	/// API for the `TreeView` component.
500	pub struct Api<'a> {
501	    /// Current machine state.
502	    state: &'a State,
503	    /// Current context.
504	    ctx:   &'a Context,
505	    /// Current props.
506	    props: &'a Props,
507	    /// Event dispatcher.
508	    send:  &'a dyn Fn(Event),
509	}
510	
511	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
512	    /// Check if a node is selected.
513	    pub fn is_node_selected(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
514	        self.ctx.selected.get().contains(&Key::from(id))
515	    }
516	
517	    /// Check if a node is expanded.
518	    pub fn is_node_expanded(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
519	        self.ctx.expanded.get().contains(id)
520	    }
521	
522	    /// Check if a node is focused.
523	    pub fn is_node_focused(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
524	        self.ctx.focused_node.as_ref().map(|k| k.as_ref()) == Some(id)
525	    }
526	
527	    /// Look up a node from the collection by key.
528	    pub fn get_node(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&ars_collections::Node<TreeItem>> {
529	        self.ctx.items.get(&Key::from(id))
530	    }
531	
532	    /// Compute (setsize, posinset) for a node from the collection.
533	    /// Returns (sibling count at this level, 1-based position among siblings).
534	    pub fn sibling_info(&self, id: &str) -> (u32, u32) {
535	        let key = Key::from(id);
536	        let node = match self.ctx.items.get(&key) { Some(n) => n, None => return (1, 1) };
537	        let siblings: Vec<_> = match &node.parent_key {
538	            Some(parent) => self.ctx.items.children_of(parent).collect(),
539	            None => {
540	                // Root-level nodes: collect all level-0 nodes
541	                self.ctx.items.nodes()
542	                    .filter(|n| n.parent_key.is_none())
543	                    .collect()
544	            }
545	        };
546	        let setsize = siblings.len() as u32;
547	        let posinset = siblings.iter()
548	            .position(|n| n.key == key)
549	            .map(|p| p as u32 + 1)
550	            .unwrap_or(1);
551	        (setsize, posinset)
552	    }
553	
554	    /// Attrs for the tree root container (`role="tree"`).
555	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
556	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
557	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "tree");
558	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
559	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
560	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
561	        if self.ctx.multiple {
562	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::MultiSelectable), "true");
563	        }
564	        if let Some(focused) = &self.ctx.focused_node {
565	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ActiveDescendant), focused);
566	        }
567	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "0");
568	        attrs
569	    }
570	
571	    /// Handle focus event for the tree view root.
572	    pub fn on_root_focus(&self) {
573	        (self.send)(Event::Focus { is_keyboard: false });
574	    }
575	
576	    /// Handle blur event for the tree view root.
577	    pub fn on_root_blur(&self) {
578	        (self.send)(Event::Blur);
579	    }
580	
581	    /// Attrs for a branch node (expandable, has children).
582	    ///
583	    /// `node_id` — unique ID. Level, setsize, posinset, and disabled state
584	    /// are derived from the `TreeCollection`.
585	    ///
586	    /// When the node's `has_children` flag is true, `aria-expanded` is always
587	    /// emitted even if the collection currently contains no children for this
588	    /// node. This is essential for lazy-loaded trees where the expand affordance
589	    /// must be present before children are fetched.
590	    pub fn branch_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
591	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
592	        let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);
593	        let is_selected = self.is_node_selected(node_id);
594	        let is_focused  = self.is_node_focused(node_id);
595	        let node = self.get_node(node_id);
596	        let level = node.map(|n| n.level as u32 + 1).unwrap_or(1); // 1-based
597	        let (setsize, posinset) = self.sibling_info(node_id);
598	        let disabled = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.disabled).unwrap_or(false);
599	        let has_children_flag = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.has_children).unwrap_or(false);
600	        let has_actual_children = node.map(|n| n.has_children).unwrap_or(false);
601	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "treeitem");
602	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Branch { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
603	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
604	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
605	        // Emit aria-expanded when the node has real children OR has_children flag is set
606	        if has_actual_children || has_children_flag {
607	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded), if is_expanded { "true" } else { "false" });
608	        }
609	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Selected), if is_selected { "true" } else { "false" });
610	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Level),   level.to_string());
611	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::SetSize), setsize.to_string());
612	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::PosInSet),posinset.to_string());
613	        if disabled { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true"); attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true); }
614	        if is_selected { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-selected"), true); }
615	        if is_expanded { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-expanded"), true); }
616	        if is_focused && self.ctx.focus_visible { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true); }
617	        attrs
618	    }
619	
620	    /// Attrs for the clickable control area inside a branch (the row the user activates).
621	    /// When the node has an `href`, sets `HtmlAttr::Href` so the adapter renders an `<a>`
622	    /// element instead of a `<div>`. The `role="treeitem"` on the parent `Branch` is preserved.
623	    pub fn branch_control_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
624	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
625	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchControl { node_id: String::new() }.data_attrs();
626	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
627	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
628	        if let Some(href) = self.get_node(node_id)
629	            .and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref())
630	            .and_then(|v| v.href.as_deref())
631	        {
632	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Href, href);
633	        }
634	        attrs
635	    }
636	
637	    /// Handle click event for the branch control.
638	    pub fn on_branch_control_click(&self, node_id: &str) {
639	        (self.send)(Event::ToggleNode(node_id.to_string()));
640	        (self.send)(Event::FocusNode(node_id.to_string()));
641	    }
642	
643	    /// Attrs for the expand/collapse chevron indicator inside a branch.
644	    pub fn branch_indicator_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
645	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
646	        let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);
647	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchIndicator { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
648	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
649	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
650	        if is_expanded { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-expanded"), true); }
651	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Hidden), "true");
652	        attrs
653	    }
654	
655	    /// Attrs for the text label inside a branch.
656	    pub fn branch_text_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
657	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
658	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchText.data_attrs();
659	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
660	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
661	        attrs
662	    }
663	
664	    /// Returns the loading indicator text for a branch node whose children are being fetched.
665	    /// Used as visually hidden text inside the branch when `load_state` is `Loading`.
666	    pub fn loading_label(&self) -> String {
667	        (self.ctx.messages.loading_label)(&self.ctx.locale)
668	    }
669	
670	    /// Attrs for the children container inside an expanded branch (`role="group"`).
671	    pub fn branch_content_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
672	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
673	        let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);
674	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "group");
675	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchContent { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
676	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
677	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
678	        if !is_expanded {
679	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Hidden, true);
680	        }
681	        attrs
682	    }
683	
684	    /// Attrs for a leaf node (no children, no expand/collapse).
685	    /// Level, setsize, posinset, and disabled state are derived from the `TreeCollection`.
686	    ///
687	    /// When the node's `has_children` flag is true (but no actual children are
688	    /// loaded), the leaf is treated as an expandable node: `aria-expanded="false"`
689	    /// is set so screen readers announce the expand affordance. Once children
690	    /// are loaded, the node transitions from `Leaf` to `Branch` in the adapter.
691	    ///
692	    /// When the node has an `href`, sets `HtmlAttr::Href` so the adapter renders
693	    /// an `<a>` element instead of the default element. `role="treeitem"` is preserved.
694	    pub fn leaf_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
695	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
696	        let is_selected = self.is_node_selected(node_id);
697	        let is_focused  = self.is_node_focused(node_id);
698	        let node = self.get_node(node_id);
699	        let level = node.map(|n| n.level as u32 + 1).unwrap_or(1);
700	        let (setsize, posinset) = self.sibling_info(node_id);
701	        let disabled = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.disabled).unwrap_or(false);
702	        let has_children_flag = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.has_children).unwrap_or(false);
703	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "treeitem");
704	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Leaf { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
705	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
706	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
707	        // When has_children is true but no children are loaded yet, show expand affordance
708	        if has_children_flag {
709	            let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);
710	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded), if is_expanded { "true" } else { "false" });
711	        }
712	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Selected), if is_selected { "true" } else { "false" });
713	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Level),    level.to_string());
714	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::SetSize),  setsize.to_string());
715	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::PosInSet), posinset.to_string());
716	        if disabled { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true"); attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true); }
717	        if is_selected { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-selected"), true); }
718	        if is_focused && self.ctx.focus_visible { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true); }
719	        // When href is present, the adapter renders this as an <a> element
720	        if let Some(href) = node
721	            .and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref())
722	            .and_then(|v| v.href.as_deref())
723	        {
724	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Href, href);
725	        }
726	        attrs
727	    }
728	
729	    /// Handle click event for the leaf node.
730	    pub fn on_leaf_click(&self, node_id: &str) {
731	        (self.send)(Event::SelectNode(node_id.to_string()));
732	        (self.send)(Event::FocusNode(node_id.to_string()));
733	    }

737	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
738	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::LeafText.data_attrs();
739	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
740	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
741	        attrs
742	    }

747	    }

754	
755	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
756	    type Part = Part;
757	
758	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
759	        match part {
760	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
761	            Part::Branch { ref node_id } => self.branch_attrs(node_id),
762	            Part::BranchControl { ref node_id } => self.branch_control_attrs(node_id),
763	            Part::BranchIndicator { ref node_id } => self.branch_indicator_attrs(node_id),
764	            Part::BranchText => self.branch_text_attrs(),
765	            Part::BranchContent { ref node_id } => self.branch_content_attrs(node_id),
766	            Part::Leaf { ref node_id } => self.leaf_attrs(node_id),
767	            Part::LeafText => self.leaf_text_attrs(),
768	        }
769	    }
770	}

772	
773	## 2. Anatomy
774	
775	```text
776	TreeView
777	└── Root                           role="tree"
778	    ├── Branch                     role="treeitem" aria-expanded
779	    │   ├── BranchControl        (clickable row; <a> when href present)
780	    │   │   ├── BranchIndicator  aria-hidden="true"
781	    │   │   └── BranchText
782	    │   └── BranchContent        role="group"
783	    │       └── (nested Branch or Leaf nodes)
784	    └── Leaf                       role="treeitem" (aria-expanded when has_children)
785	        └── LeafText             (<a> when href present)
786	```
787	
788	| Part              | Element                               | Key Attributes                                                                                                                                                                                              |
789	| ----------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
790	| `Root`            | `<ul>` or `<div>`                     | `data-ars-scope="tree-view"`, `data-ars-part="root"`, `role="tree"`, `aria-multiselectable`                                                                                                                 |
791	| `Branch`          | `<li>` or `<div>`                     | `role="treeitem"`, `aria-expanded` (also set when `has_children` is true with no loaded children), `aria-selected`, `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset`, `data-ars-expanded`, `data-ars-selected` |
792	| `BranchControl`   | `<div>` or `<a>` (when href)          | `data-ars-scope="tree-view"`, `data-ars-part="branch-control"`, `href` (when present)                                                                                                                       |
793	| `BranchIndicator` | `<span>`                              | `data-ars-scope="tree-view"`, `data-ars-part="branch-indicator"`, `aria-hidden="true"`, `data-ars-expanded`                                                                                                 |
794	| `BranchText`      | `<span>`                              | `data-ars-scope="tree-view"`, `data-ars-part="branch-text"`                                                                                                                                                 |
795	| `BranchContent`   | `<ul>` or `<div>`                     | `role="group"`, `data-ars-scope="tree-view"`, `data-ars-part="branch-content"`                                                                                                                              |
796	| `Leaf`            | `<li>`, `<div>`, or `<a>` (when href) | `role="treeitem"`, `aria-expanded="false"` (when `has_children` is true), `aria-selected`, `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset`, `data-ars-selected`, `href` (when present)                        |
797	| `LeafText`        | `<span>`                              | `data-ars-scope="tree-view"`, `data-ars-part="leaf-text"`                                                                                                                                                   |
798	
799	## 3. Accessibility
800	
801	- While loading, the expandable node shows `aria-busy="true"`.
802	- A visually hidden "Loading" text (from Messages) is announced via `aria-live="polite"`.
803	- On error, the node shows an error state and retry affordance with appropriate `aria-label`.
804	
805	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
806	
807	| Part            | Role       | Properties                                                                                                                                                                |
808	| --------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
809	| `Root`          | `tree`     | `aria-multiselectable="true"` when `multiple=true`                                                                                                                        |
810	| `Branch`        | `treeitem` | `aria-expanded="true\|false"` (emitted when node has children or `has_children` is true), `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset` |
811	| `BranchContent` | `group`    | —                                                                                                                                                                         |
812	| `Leaf`          | `treeitem` | `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset`. When `has_children` is true: also `aria-expanded="false"`                                |
813	
814	When a tree item has an `href`, the adapter renders the clickable area (`BranchControl` or
815	`Leaf`) as an `<a>` element. The `role="treeitem"` on the parent `Branch`/`Leaf` container is
816	preserved — the `<a>` is a descendant of the `role="treeitem"` element, not a replacement for
817	it. This allows native link semantics (middle-click, Ctrl+click) while maintaining the ARIA tree
818	pattern.
819	
820	`aria-level` reflects DOM nesting depth (1-based). `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` enable
821	screen readers to announce "item 3 of 5" when navigating.
822	
823	**Parent-child ARIA relationships:** The DOM hierarchy is sufficient to establish parent-child
824	relationships — `aria-owns` is NOT used because children are rendered as direct DOM descendants
825	of their parent treeitem. Branch children are wrapped in a `BranchContent` element with
826	`role="group"` (see anatomy table above), which groups the child treeitems under the parent
827	branch. This `role="group"` container is what allows screen readers to determine nesting
828	without `aria-owns`. If an adapter renders children outside the parent's DOM subtree (e.g., via
829	portals), it MUST add `aria-owns` on the parent `treeitem` referencing the `role="group"`
830	container's ID.
831	
832	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
833	
834	| Key                 | Behavior                                                                                                         |
835	| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
836	| `ArrowDown`         | Move focus to the next visible node (skips hidden children of collapsed branches).                               |
837	| `ArrowUp`           | Move focus to the previous visible node.                                                                         |
838	| `ArrowRight`        | If focused node is a collapsed branch: expand it. If already expanded (or a leaf): move focus to first child.    |
839	| `ArrowLeft`         | If focused node is an expanded branch: collapse it. If collapsed (or a leaf): move focus to parent.              |
840	| `Home`              | Move focus to the first node in the tree.                                                                        |
841	| `End`               | Move focus to the last visible node in the tree.                                                                 |
842	| `Enter`             | Select the focused node (if `selection_mode != None`).                                                           |
843	| `Space`             | Toggle selection of the focused node (in multiple mode).                                                         |
844	| `*` (asterisk)      | Expand all siblings of the focused node.                                                                         |
845	| `F2`                | Start inline rename on the focused node (when `renamable` is true). See [section 6](#6-variant-renamable-nodes). |
846	| Printable character | Typeahead: jump to the next node whose visible label starts with the typed character.                            |
847	
848	### 3.3 RTL Navigation Semantics
849	
850	`TreeView` keyboard navigation uses **logical** (not visual) semantics that remain consistent regardless of text direction. In both LTR and RTL layouts:
851	
852	- **ArrowRight / ArrowDown** = expand a collapsed branch, or navigate to the first child of an expanded branch.
853	- **ArrowLeft / ArrowUp** = collapse an expanded branch, or navigate to the parent node.
854	
855	This matches the WAI-ARIA `TreeView` pattern, where ArrowRight/ArrowLeft map to expand/collapse (parent-child hierarchy), not to visual direction. The adapter does **not** swap ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in RTL mode for `TreeView`, unlike flat list components (`Accordion`, `Tabs`) where arrows map to next/previous sibling. The rationale is that tree hierarchy is a logical relationship independent of layout direction.
856	
857	### 3.4 Selection Announcements
858	
859	- Selected items have `aria-selected="true"` (already present)
860	- Selection changes are announced via focus movement to the selected node
861	- For programmatic selection changes (no focus change), use LiveAnnouncer:
862	  `announce("{item label} selected", "polite")`
863	
864	### 3.5 Scroll Into View
865	
866	When focus moves to an off-screen tree item, the adapter scrolls it into view using `element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' })`. For nested scrollable containers, the adapter must walk up the DOM and call `scrollIntoView` on the closest scrollable ancestor only. On iOS Safari, where programmatic focus doesn't trigger scroll, the adapter must explicitly call `scrollIntoView` after `element.focus()`. Smooth scrolling is avoided for keyboard navigation to prevent timing conflicts.
867	
868	### 3.6 Expand/Collapse Keyboard Navigation Race Conditions
869	
870	Rapid keyboard interactions on `TreeView` nodes can cause race conditions between expand/collapse animations and focus movement:
871	
872	1. **Debounce Expansion**: Expand/collapse transitions are not debounced — each ArrowRight (expand) or ArrowLeft (collapse) takes effect immediately. However, the focus movement that follows expansion (ArrowRight on expanded node moves focus to first child) waits until the children are actually rendered.
873	2. **Pending Expansion Guard**: If ArrowRight is pressed on a collapsed node, the node enters an "expanding" state. A second ArrowRight during this state is queued and executed after children render (moving focus to the first child), rather than being ignored.
874	3. **Collapse During Focus-In-Child**: If ArrowLeft collapses a parent while focus is on a child, focus moves to the parent node before the collapse animation starts. The adapter must move focus synchronously, then animate the collapse.
875	4. **Async Children**: For lazily-loaded children (`on_expand` triggers async fetch), the node shows a loading indicator and expansion completes when children arrive. ArrowRight during loading is a no-op.
876	
877	## 4. Internationalization
878	
879	- **RTL**: Arrow key meanings are not reversed for trees (tree nesting is not direction-dependent).
880	  The visual chevron indicator flips via CSS using `[dir="rtl"]`.
881	- **Typeahead**: Character matching is case-insensitive and uses the locale's collation when
882	  available (delegated to `ars-i18n`).
883	- **Label text**: All node labels are consumer-provided. The machine emits a `loading_label` for lazy-loaded branches (see §4.1 Messages).
884	
885	### 4.1 Messages
886	
887	```rust
888	/// Locale-specific labels for the TreeView component.
889	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
890	pub struct Messages {
891	    /// Loading indicator text for branches whose children are being fetched
892	    /// (default: "Loading…"). Rendered as visually hidden text and announced
893	    /// via `aria-live="polite"`.
894	    pub loading_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
895	}
896	
897	impl Default for Messages {
898	    fn default() -> Self {
899	        Self {
900	            loading_label: MessageFn::static_str("Loading\u{2026}"),
901	        }
902	    }
903	}
904	
905	impl ComponentMessages for Messages {}
906	```
907	
908	> **Drag and Drop Reorder**: When `dnd_enabled: true` is set, TreeView integrates with `DraggableCollection<T>` and `DroppableCollection<T>` from `06-collections.md` §7. This adds optional `drag::Handle` and `drop::Indicator` anatomy parts. TreeView supports both `CollectionDndEvent::Reorder` (reordering siblings) and `CollectionDndEvent::Move` (reparenting nodes by dropping onto a parent item with `drop::Position::On`).
909	
910	### 4.2 Drag-Reorder Behavior
911	
912	When drag-and-drop reorder is enabled (`dnd_enabled: true`), the following behaviors apply:
913	
914	- **Drag handle**: Each tree item renders an optional drag handle affordance (the `drag::Handle` anatomy part). The handle is the grab target; the entire row is not draggable by default to avoid conflicts with text selection.
915	- **Hover-expand**: When dragging over a collapsed tree node, the node automatically expands after a 500ms hover delay. This allows users to drop items into nested levels without manually expanding first.
916	- **Drop target indication**: Valid drop zones are visually highlighted during drag. Three drop positions are supported:
917	  - `Before` — insert before the target node (horizontal line above)
918	  - `After` — insert after the target node (horizontal line below)
919	  - `Child` — insert as a child of the target node (target node background highlight)
920	- **Drop position detection**: The drop position is determined by the pointer's vertical position within the target row: top 25% = `Before`, bottom 25% = `After`, middle 50% = `Child`.
921	- **Keyboard drag**: Full keyboard support for reordering:
922	  - `Enter` or `Space` on a focused drag handle to pick up the item
923	  - Arrow keys to move the item through valid drop positions
924	  - `Enter` to confirm the drop
925	  - `Escape` to cancel and return the item to its original position
926	- **Reorder callback**: `on_reorder: Callback<ReorderEvent>` fires when a drop is completed.
927	
928	```rust
929	/// Event emitted when a tree item is reordered via drag-and-drop.
930	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
931	pub struct ReorderEvent {
932	    /// Path of the dragged item (sequence of keys from root to item).
933	    pub source_path: Vec<Key>,
934	    /// Path of the drop target.
935	    pub target_path: Vec<Key>,

943	## 5. Variant: Lazy Loading
944	
945	`TreeView` supports lazy loading of child nodes for large or server-driven hierarchies. When a node is first expanded and its children are not yet loaded, the machine fires a `LoadChildren` event.
946	
947	### 5.1 Additional Props
948	
949	```rust,no_check
950	/// The load_children callback is registered in the adapter layer, not in Props.
951	/// When provided, nodes without pre-loaded children will trigger lazy loading on expand.
952	/// The adapter observes `LoadChildren(Key)` events and calls the user-provided callback.
953	```
954	
955	```rust
956	/// Type alias for the lazy-load callback.
957	/// The adapter calls this with the parent node's key when children need loading.
958	/// The callback should eventually send a `ChildrenLoaded` event back to the machine.
959	/// Uses `Rc` so the adapter can clone it into event handler closures.
960	pub type LoadChildrenFn = Rc<dyn Fn(Key)>;
961	```
962	
963	### 5.2 Additional Events
964	
965	```rust,no_check
966	/// Added to TreeView Event enum.
967	/// Fired when a node is expanded for the first time and has no children loaded.
968	LoadChildren(Key),
969	/// Fired by the consumer (via adapter callback) when lazy-loaded children arrive.
970	ChildrenLoaded {
971	    /// The parent node key.
972	    parent: Key,
973	    /// The loaded children nodes.
974	    children: Vec<Node<T>>,
975	},
976	```
977	
978	### 5.3 Additional Node State
979	
980	```rust
981	/// Extended NodeState to include loading.
982	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
983	pub enum NodeLoadState {
984	    /// Children are present in the collection.
985	    Loaded,
986	    /// Children are being fetched (loading indicator shown).
987	    Loading,
988	    /// Load failed — adapter may show retry affordance.
989	    Error,
990	    /// Children have not been requested yet (initial state for lazy nodes).
991	    NotLoaded,
992	}
993	```
994	
995	The `tree_view::Context` tracks `load_state: BTreeMap<Key, NodeLoadState>`.
996	
997	### 5.4 Behavior
998	
999	1. User expands a node whose `load_state` is `NotLoaded`.
1000	2. Machine transitions `load_state` to `Loading` and fires `LoadChildren(key)`.
1001	3. Adapter calls `load_children(key)` prop. The consumer fetches data asynchronously.
1002	4. Consumer sends `ChildrenLoaded { parent, children }` when data arrives.
1003	5. Machine inserts children into the collection and transitions `load_state` to `Loaded`.
1004	6. If loading fails, consumer sends `LoadError(key)` and machine transitions to `Error`.
1005	
1006	## 6. Variant: Renamable Nodes
1007	
1008	`TreeView` supports inline rename of tree nodes, similar to file-explorer rename behavior.
1009	When enabled, users can start renaming a node via F2 or slow double-click. The node's text
1010	display is replaced by an inline `<input>` element until the rename is committed or cancelled.
1011	
1012	### 6.1 Additional Props
1013	
1014	```rust,no_check
1015	/// Additional props for the renamable variant.
1016	impl Props {
1017	    /// When true, tree items can be renamed inline via F2 or slow double-click.
1018	    /// Default: `false`.
1019	    pub renamable: bool,
1020	}
1021	
1022	// In Props::default():
1023	// renamable: false,
1024	```
1025	
1026	### 6.2 Additional Events
1027	
1028	```rust,no_check
1029	/// Added to TreeView Event enum for the renamable variant.
1030	
1031	/// User initiates rename on a node (e.g., F2 or slow double-click).
1032	RenameStart(Key),
1033	/// User commits the new name.
1034	RenameCommit { key: Key, new_name: String },
1035	/// User cancels rename (Escape or blur without change).
1036	RenameCancel(Key),
1037	```
1038	
1039	### 6.3 Additional Context
1040	
1041	```rust,no_check
1042	/// Added to TreeView Context for the renamable variant.
1043	impl Context {
1044	    /// The node currently being renamed, if any. When `Some(key)`, the node
1045	    /// identified by `key` renders a `NodeRenameInput` instead of its text label.
1046	    pub renaming_key: Option<Key>,
1047	}
1048	
1049	// In Machine::init():
1050	// renaming_key: None,
1051	```
1052	
1053	### 6.4 Behavior
1054	
1055	- **`RenameStart(key)`**: Only allowed from `Idle` or `Focused` states. If `renamable` is
1056	  false or the target node is disabled, the event is ignored. If another node is currently
1057	  being renamed (`renaming_key` is `Some(other_key)`), that rename is committed first (fires
1058	  `RenameCommit` for the previous node with its current input value), then `renaming_key` is
1059	  set to `Some(key)`. Focus moves to the rename input.
1060	- **`RenameCommit { key, new_name }`**: Clears `renaming_key` to `None`. The consumer is
1061	  responsible for persisting the new name (e.g., updating the `TreeCollection` data source).
1062	  The machine does not modify the `TreeItem.label` — the consumer updates the collection and
1063	  passes new props.
1064	- **`RenameCancel(key)`**: Clears `renaming_key` to `None`. No value change occurs. Focus
1065	  returns to the tree item that was being renamed.
1066	
1067	```rust,no_check
1068	/// Transition logic for rename events.
1069	/// Added to the Machine::transition match block.
1070	
1071	Event::RenameStart(key) => {
1072	    if !_props.renamable { return None; }
1073	    let node_disabled = ctx.items.get(key)
1074	        .and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref())
1075	        .map(|v| v.disabled)
1076	        .unwrap_or(false);
1077	    if node_disabled { return None; }
1078	    match state {
1079	        State::Idle | State::Focused => {
1080	            let key = key.clone();
1081	            Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
1082	                ctx.renaming_key = Some(key.clone());
1083	                ctx.focused_node = Some(key);
1084	            }))
1085	        }
1086	        _ => None,
1087	    }
1088	}
1089	
1090	Event::RenameCommit { key, .. } => {
1091	    if ctx.renaming_key.as_ref() != Some(key) { return None; }
1092	    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
1093	        ctx.renaming_key = None;
1094	    }))
1095	}
1096	
1097	Event::RenameCancel(key) => {
1098	    if ctx.renaming_key.as_ref() != Some(key) { return None; }
1099	    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
1100	        ctx.renaming_key = None;
1101	    }))
1102	}
1103	```
1104	
1105	### 6.5 Anatomy Additions
1106	
1107	```text
1108	TreeView (renamable variant)
1109	└── Root
1110	    ├── Branch
1111	    │   ├── BranchControl
1112	    │   │   ├── BranchIndicator
1113	    │   │   ├── BranchText           (hidden when renaming_key matches)
1114	    │   │   └── NodeRenameInput(key)   (shown when renaming_key matches)
1115	    │   └── BranchContent
1116	    └── Leaf
1117	        ├── LeafText                 (hidden when renaming_key matches)
1118	        └── NodeRenameInput(key)       (shown when renaming_key matches)
1119	```
1120	
1121	The `NodeRenameInput(Key)` part is an `<input type="text">` element rendered inside the
1122	branch control or leaf when `renaming_key == Some(key)`. It replaces the text display during
1123	rename and is pre-filled with the node's current `label` value.
1124	
1125	```rust,no_check
1126	/// Added to Part enum.
1127	NodeRenameInput { node_id: String },
1128	```
1129	
1130	```rust
1131	/// Attrs for the inline rename input.
1132	/// Rendered only when `renaming_key == Some(key)` for this node.
1133	pub fn node_rename_input_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
1134	    let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
1135	    let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] =
1136	        Part::NodeRenameInput { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
1137	    attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
1138	    attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
1139	    let label = self.get_node(node_id)
1140	        .and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref())
1141	        .map(|v| v.label.as_str())
1142	        .unwrap_or("");
1143	    attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "text");
1144	    attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, label);
1145	    attrs.set(
1146	        HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),
1147	        (self.ctx.messages.rename_label)(label, &self.ctx.locale),
1148	    );
1149	    attrs
1150	}
1151	
1152	/// Handle keydown events on the rename input.
1153	pub fn on_rename_input_keydown(&self, node_id: &str, key_code: &str, current_value: &str) {
1154	    match key_code {
1155	        "Enter" => {
1156	            (self.send)(Event::RenameCommit {
1157	                key: Key::from(node_id),
1158	                new_name: current_value.to_string(),
1159	            });
1160	        }
1161	        "Escape" => {
1162	            (self.send)(Event::RenameCancel(Key::from(node_id)));
1163	        }
1164	        _ => {}
1165	    }
1166	}
1167	
1168	/// Handle blur on the rename input — commits the rename if still active.
1169	pub fn on_rename_input_blur(&self, node_id: &str, current_value: &str) {
1170	    let key = Key::from(node_id);
1171	    if self.ctx.renaming_key.as_ref() == Some(&key) {
1172	        (self.send)(Event::RenameCommit {
1173	            key,
1174	            new_name: current_value.to_string(),
1175	        });
1176	    }
1177	}
1178	
1179	/// Check if a node is currently being renamed.
1180	pub fn is_renaming(&self, node_id: &str) -> bool {
1181	    self.ctx.renaming_key.as_ref().map(|k| k.as_ref()) == Some(node_id)
1182	}
1183	```
1184	
1185	The `part_attrs` match is extended:
1186	
1187	```rust,no_check
1188	Part::NodeRenameInput { ref node_id } => self.node_rename_input_attrs(node_id),
1189	```
1190	
1191	### 6.6 Accessibility
1192	
1193	| Key      | Behavior                                                       |
1194	| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
1195	| `F2`     | Start rename on the focused node (when `renamable` is true).   |
1196	| `Enter`  | Commit the rename (when rename input is focused).              |
1197	| `Escape` | Cancel the rename, discard changes, return focus to tree item. |
1198	
1199	- The `NodeRenameInput` receives `aria-label` from `Messages.rename_label`, which receives
1200	  the node's current label as the first argument. Screen readers announce e.g.,
1201	  "Rename Documents" when focus enters the input.
1202	- When rename starts, focus moves to the `NodeRenameInput`. When rename ends (commit or
1203	  cancel), focus returns to the tree item.
1204	- The rename input is not part of the tab sequence (`tabindex="-1"` is not needed because
1205	  it is a native `<input>` that receives focus programmatically).
1206	
1207	### 6.7 Messages
1208

1211	impl Messages {
1212	    /// Accessible label for the rename input. Called with the node's current
1213	    /// label and the resolved locale.
1214	    /// Default: `|node_name, _locale| format!("Rename {}", node_name)`
1215	    pub rename_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&str, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1216	}
1217	
1218	// In Messages::default():
1219	// rename_label: MessageFn::new(|node_name, _locale| format!("Rename {}", node_name)),
1220	```
1221	
1222	## 7. Library Parity
1223	
1224	> Compared against: Ark UI (`TreeView`), React Aria (`Tree`).
1225	
1226	### 7.1 Props
1227	
1228	| Feature             | ars-ui                             | Ark UI                                 | React Aria                     | Notes                                       |
1229	| ------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
1230	| Tree data source    | `items: TreeCollection<TreeItem>`  | `collection: TreeCollection<T>`        | `items: Iterable<T>`           | All provide collection-based API            |
1231	| Controlled selected | `selected`                         | --                                     | `selectedKeys`                 | Ark uses context API                        |
1232	| Default selected    | `default_selected`                 | `defaultSelectedValue`                 | `defaultSelectedKeys`          | Full match                                  |
1233	| Controlled expanded | `expanded`                         | `expandedValue`                        | `expandedKeys`                 | Full match                                  |
1234	| Default expanded    | `default_expanded`                 | `defaultExpandedValue`                 | `defaultExpandedKeys`          | Full match                                  |
1235	| Selection mode      | `selection_mode`                   | `selectionMode`                        | `selectionMode`                | Full match                                  |
1236	| Selection behavior  | `selection_behavior`               | --                                     | `selectionBehavior`            | ars-ui matches React Aria                   |
1237	| Multiple selection  | `multiple`                         | --                                     | --                             | Expressed via `selection_mode` in all       |
1238	| Disabled keys       | per-item `disabled` field          | --                                     | `disabledKeys`                 | ars-ui uses per-item field in TreeItem      |
1239	| Disabled behavior   | --                                 | --                                     | `disabledBehavior`             | See below                                   |
1240	| Typeahead           | via `TypeaheadSearch` event        | `typeahead`                            | --                             | ars-ui always has typeahead                 |
1241	| Expand on click     | via `on_branch_control_click`      | `expandOnClick`                        | --                             | ars-ui expands on click by default          |
1242	| Lazy loading        | `LoadChildren` variant (section 5) | `loadChildren`                         | --                             | ars-ui has full lazy-load variant           |
1243	| Renamable           | `renamable` variant (section 6)    | `canRename`                            | --                             | ars-ui has full renamable variant           |
1244	| Checked (checkbox)  | --                                 | `checkedValue` / `defaultCheckedValue` | --                             | See below                                   |
1245	| DnD                 | DnD variant (section 4.2)          | --                                     | `dragAndDropHooks`             | ars-ui has full DnD variant                 |
1246	| Escape key behavior | --                                 | --                                     | `escapeKeyBehavior`            | See below                                   |
1247	| Virtualization      | --                                 | `scrollToIndexFn`                      | --                             | Adapter-level concern                       |
1248	| Focused value       | --                                 | `focusedValue` / `defaultFocusedValue` | --                             | ars-ui tracks via `focused_node` in Context |
1249	| Has children flag   | `TreeItem.has_children`            | --                                     | `hasChildItems` (per TreeItem) | Full match                                  |
1250	| Node href           | `TreeItem.href`                    | --                                     | `href` (per TreeItem)          | ars-ui matches React Aria                   |
1251	| Empty state         | --                                 | --                                     | `renderEmptyState`             | Adapter concern                             |
1252	| On action           | --                                 | --                                     | `onAction`                     | See below                                   |
1253	
1254	**Gaps:**
1255	
1256	- **`disabledBehavior`**: React Aria supports `'all' | 'selection'` to control whether disabled items block all interaction or only selection. ars-ui disabled items block all interaction. Low priority -- `'selection'` mode is niche.
1257	- **`checkedValue` (tri-state checkboxes)**: Ark UI supports per-node checkboxes with `checked`/`unchecked`/`indeterminate` states, including `NodeCheckbox` and `NodeCheckboxIndicator` anatomy. ars-ui could add this as a variant, but it is a specialized use case. Low priority.
1258	- **`escapeKeyBehavior`**: React Aria allows `'clearSelection' | 'none'` on Escape press. ars-ui does not currently handle Escape in the tree. Low priority.
1259	- **`onAction`**: React Aria fires `onAction(Key)` when a tree item is activated (Enter/click). ars-ui handles this via `SelectNode` event. The consumer can observe selection changes. Low priority.
1260	
1261	### 7.2 Anatomy
1262	
1263	| Part                | ars-ui            | Ark UI                                   | React Aria                   | Notes                              |
1264	| ------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
1265	| Root                | `Root`            | `Root`                                   | `Tree`                       | Full match                         |
1266	| Label               | --                | `Label`                                  | --                           | Ark has optional tree label        |
1267	| Tree list           | --                | `Tree`                                   | --                           | Ark separates Root from Tree list  |
1268	| Branch node         | `Branch`          | `Branch`                                 | `TreeItem` (with children)   | Full match                         |
1269	| Branch control      | `BranchControl`   | `BranchControl`                          | --                           | ars-ui and Ark have this           |
1270	| Branch indicator    | `BranchIndicator` | `BranchIndicator`                        | --                           | ars-ui and Ark have this           |
1271	| Branch text         | `BranchText`      | `BranchText`                             | --                           | ars-ui and Ark have this           |
1272	| Branch content      | `BranchContent`   | `BranchContent`                          | --                           | ars-ui and Ark have this           |
1273	| Branch indent guide | --                | `BranchIndentGuide`                      | --                           | Purely visual; adapter concern     |
1274	| Leaf node           | `Leaf`            | `Item`                                   | `TreeItem` (no children)     | Full match                         |
1275	| Leaf text           | `LeafText`        | `ItemText`                               | --                           | ars-ui and Ark have this           |
1276	| Node checkbox       | --                | `NodeCheckbox` / `NodeCheckboxIndicator` | --                           | Ark-only tri-state checkbox        |
1277	| Rename input        | `NodeRenameInput` | `NodeRenameInput`                        | --                           | ars-ui and Ark have this           |
1278	| Node provider       | --                | `NodeProvider`                           | --                           | Ark-specific context provider      |
1279	| Item content        | --                | --                                       | `TreeItemContent`            | React Aria render prop wrapper     |
1280	| Section             | --                | --                                       | `TreeSection` / `TreeHeader` | React Aria grouping; not in ars-ui |
1281	| Load more item      | --                | --                                       | `TreeLoadMoreItem`           | React Aria infinite scroll trigger |
1282	
1283	**Gaps:**
1284	
1285	- **`BranchIndentGuide`**: Ark UI has a dedicated indent guide part for rendering vertical tree lines. This is purely a CSS/visual concern and can be achieved via CSS `::before` pseudo-elements on Branch nodes in ars-ui. Not worth adding as a formal part.
1286	- **`Label`**: Ark UI has a `Label` part for the tree's accessible name. ars-ui achieves this via `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on the Root element, which is the standard ARIA approach. No gap.
1287	- **`TreeSection` / `TreeHeader`**: React Aria supports grouping tree items into labeled sections. This is an advanced composition pattern; consumers can achieve this by structuring their TreeCollection data appropriately. Low priority.
1288	
1289	### 7.3 Events
1290	
1291	| Callback            | ars-ui                | Ark UI                   | React Aria          | Notes                         |
1292	| ------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------- |
1293	| Selection change    | `Bindable` onChange   | `onSelectionChange`      | `onSelectionChange` | ars-ui uses Bindable pattern  |
1294	| Expanded change     | `Bindable` onChange   | `onExpandedChange`       | `onExpandedChange`  | ars-ui uses Bindable pattern  |
1295	| Focus change        | `Focus`/`Blur` events | `onFocusChange`          | --                  | ars-ui and Ark track focus    |
1296	| Checked change      | --                    | `onCheckedChange`        | --                  | Ark-only; see checkbox gap    |
1297	| Rename start        | `RenameStart`         | `onRenameStart`          | --                  | ars-ui and Ark have this      |
1298	| Rename complete     | `RenameCommit`        | `onRenameComplete`       | --                  | ars-ui and Ark have this      |
1299	| Before rename       | --                    | `onBeforeRename`         | --                  | Ark has pre-rename validation |
1300	| Load children done  | `ChildrenLoaded`      | `onLoadChildrenComplete` | --                  | ars-ui and Ark have this      |
1301	| Load children error | `LoadError` (implied) | `onLoadChildrenError`    | --                  | ars-ui and Ark have this      |
1302	| Action              | --                    | --                       | `onAction`          | React Aria item activation    |
1303	
1304	**Gaps:** None that need addressing. `onBeforeRename` can be implemented by the consumer handling `RenameStart` and conditionally allowing it. `onAction` is covered by `SelectNode` semantics.
1305	
1306	### 7.4 Features
1307	
1308	| Feature                      | ars-ui        | Ark UI            | React Aria  |
1309	| ---------------------------- | ------------- | ----------------- | ----------- |
1310	| Expand/collapse              | Yes           | Yes               | Yes         |
1311	| Single/multiple selection    | Yes           | Yes               | Yes         |
1312	| Keyboard navigation (arrows) | Yes           | Yes               | Yes         |
1313	| Typeahead search             | Yes           | Yes               | No          |
1314	| Drag and drop                | Yes (variant) | No                | Yes         |
1315	| Lazy loading                 | Yes (variant) | Yes               | No          |
1316	| Inline rename                | Yes (variant) | Yes               | No          |
1317	| RTL support                  | Yes           | Yes               | Yes         |
1318	| Per-node disabled            | Yes           | Yes               | Yes         |
1319	| Tri-state checkboxes         | No            | Yes               | No          |
1320	| Virtualization               | Adapter-level | `scrollToIndexFn` | Virtualizer |
1321	| Expand all / collapse all    | Yes           | Via context API   | No          |
1322	
1323	**Gaps:** Tri-state checkboxes (Ark-only) are a specialized feature not essential for v1.
1324	
1325	### 7.5 Summary
1326	
1327	- **Overall:** Full parity with React Aria. Near-full parity with Ark UI (missing tri-state checkboxes).
1328	- **Divergences:** ars-ui uses per-item `disabled` field in `TreeItem` rather than a `disabledKeys` set (React Aria style). Ark's `BranchIndentGuide` is a CSS concern. ars-ui separates lazy loading and rename into explicit variants rather than always-available props.
1329	- **Recommended additions:** None for v1. Tri-state node checkboxes could be added as a future variant if demand warrants.
1330

## Key Integration Notes for TreeView Spec

1. **TreeCollection::new() takes `impl IntoIterator<Item = TreeItemConfig<T>>`** — commonly `Vec<TreeItemConfig<T>>` or a slice; each config has `key`, `text_value`, `value`, `children: Vec<...>`, and `default_expanded: bool`.

2. **Node fields are direct public fields**, not methods — no `.level()` call needed; access as `node.level`.

3. **Visibility distinction**: 
   - `visible_keys()` / `nodes()` / `keys()` return **only visible** items (respecting collapsed state).
   - `children_of(parent_key)` returns **all direct children** (visible or hidden).
   - `get(key)` works on **any** key, visible or not.

4. **Key ordering** is `Int < Uuid < String`; does NOT implement `Borrow<str>` — cannot use `.as_str()` with `BTreeSet<Key>::contains()`.

5. **selection::State** is **immutable**; all mutation methods return new `State` instances (functional pattern). Use `state.select(key)`, `state.deselect(key)`, etc. to get new states.

6. **`set_expanded()` on TreeCollection** returns **new instance**; original is unchanged. This fits reactive signal patterns where you create new values rather than mutate.

```rust
pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
    let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
    let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();

    attrs
        .set(scope_attr, scope_val)
        .set(part_attr, part_val)
        .set(
            HtmlAttr::Data("ars-orientation"),
            orientation_token(self.ctx.orientation),
        )
        .set(HtmlAttr::Dir, self.ctx.dir.as_html_attr());

    if self.ctx.disabled {
        attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true);
    }

    attrs
}
```

**From ars_core** - `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/task-267/crates/ars-core/src/lib.rs` (lines 480-561):

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Bindable<T: BindableValue> {
    controlled: Option<T>,
    internal: T,
}

impl<T: BindableValue> Bindable<T> {
    #[must_use]
    pub fn controlled(value: T) -> Self {
        Self {
            internal: value.clone(),
            controlled: Some(value),
        }
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub const fn uncontrolled(default: T) -> Self {
        Self {
            controlled: None,
            internal: default,
        }
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn get(&self) -> &T {
        self.controlled.as_ref().unwrap_or(&self.internal)
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub const fn is_controlled(&self) -> bool {
        self.controlled.is_some()
    }

    pub fn set(&mut self, value: T) {
        self.internal = value;
    }

    pub fn sync_controlled(&mut self, value: Option<T>) {
        self.controlled = value;
    }

    pub const fn get_mut_owned(&mut self) -> &mut T {
        &mut self.internal
    }
}
```

### 3. **Spec-Conformance Tests: Exact Pattern**

**Helper Function:**

```rust
pub(crate) fn assert_anatomy<P>(expected_scope: &'static str, expected_parts: &[(P, &'static str)])
where
    P: ComponentPart + core::fmt::Debug + PartialEq,
{
    assert_eq!(
        P::scope(),
        expected_scope,
        "Part::scope() must match spec §3 anatomy",
    );

    let actual = P::all();
    let actual_names = actual.iter().map(ComponentPart::name).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let expected_names = expected_parts
        .iter()
        .map(|(_, name)| *name)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();

    assert_eq!(
        actual_names, expected_names,
        "Part::all() name list must equal spec §3 anatomy column",
    );
    
    // ... more assertions checking Part::ROOT, part values, etc.
}
```

```rust
use proptest::test_runner::{Config, FileFailurePersistence};

#[must_use]
pub(super) fn proptest_config() -> Config {
    let cases = std::env::var("PROPTEST_CASES")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(1000);

    Config {
        cases,
        failure_persistence: Some(Box::new(FileFailurePersistence::Direct(
            "proptest-regressions/state-machines.txt",
        ))),
        ..Config::default()
    }
}
```

```rust
fn assert_accordion_invariants(service: &Service<accordion::Machine>) -> TestCaseResult {
    let ctx = service.context();

    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();

    for item in &ctx.items {
        prop_assert!(
            seen.insert(item.clone()),
            "duplicate registered item {item:?}"
        );
    }

    if !ctx.multiple {
        prop_assert!(
            ctx.value.get().len() <= 1,
            "single accordion has multiple open values: {:?}",
            ctx.value.get()
        );
    }

    // ... more invariants
    Ok(())
}

fn assert_accordion_trigger_attr_shape(service: &Service<accordion::Machine>) -> TestCaseResult {
    let api = service.connect(&|_| {});

    for item in &service.context().items {
        let attrs = api.item_trigger_attrs(item, false);

        prop_assert!(
            attrs.get(&HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded)).is_some(),
            "aria-expanded missing"
        );
        // ... more attr assertions
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

**proptest! Block:**

Location: `/crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/input/checkbox.rs` lines 76-117

```rust
proptest! {
    #![proptest_config(crate::common::proptest_config())]

    #[test]
    #[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]
    fn proptest_checkbox_event_sequences_preserve_invariants(
        props in arb_checkbox_props(),
        events in prop::collection::vec(arb_checkbox_event(), 0..128),
    ) {
        let mut service = Service::<checkbox::Machine>::new(
            props,
            &Env::default(),
            &checkbox::Messages,
        );

        for event in events {
            drop(service.send(event));

            let state = *service.state();

            prop_assert_eq!(service.context().ids.id(), "checkbox");
            prop_assert_eq!(service.context().checked.get(), &state);

            let control_attrs = service.connect(&|_| {}).control_attrs();

            prop_assert_eq!(
                control_attrs.get(&HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Checked)),
                Some(aria_checked_token(state))
            );
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
            &Messages::default(),
        );
```

### 5. **How to Construct a Machine in Tests: Exact Patterns**

```rust
fn service(props: Props) -> Service<Machine> {
    Service::<Machine>::new(props, &Env::default(), &Messages)
}

// Usage:

drop(service.send(Event::ExpandItem(key("b"))));

```

**Pattern 2: Tabs Component (Separate Test File)**

Location: `/crates/ars-components/src/navigation/tabs/tests.rs` lines 54-88

```rust
fn test_props() -> Props {
    Props {
        id: "tabs".to_string(),
        default_value: Some(key("a")),
        ..Props::default()
    }
}

fn service_with_tabs(props: Props, tabs: &[Key]) -> Service<Machine> {
    let mut service = Service::<Machine>::new(props, &Env::default(), &Messages::default());

    let registrations = tabs
        .iter()
        .cloned()
        .map(TabRegistration::new)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();

    drop(service.send(Event::SetTabs(registrations)));

    service
}

// Usage:
let service = service_with_tabs(test_props(), &[key("a"), key("b")]);
let api = service.connect(&|_| {});
```

> AGENT

Confirmed: `TreeCollection::nodes()` returns **visible-only** nodes (iterates `visible_indices`), so the spec's `ExpandAll` (which uses `nodes()` to find every expandable node) cannot reach expandable nodes hidden under collapsed parents. Also `Key` does not implement `Borrow<str>`, so the spec's `String`-based `.contains(id)` / `set.insert(id)` calls won't compile against `BTreeSet<Key>`. Let me verify a couple more things: how effect-less machines declare `type Effect`, the navigation test-file layout, and `Key`'s string accessors.

> AGENT

I have enough to design the plan. Two findings require your input before I finalize, because they're deliberate deviations from the written spec that change the public API and scope.

Key context for the questions:
- The tree-view spec types node identity as `String` (event payloads like `ExpandNode(String)`, Api params like `branch_attrs(node_id: &str)`). But every sibling component (Accordion, Tabs) and the documented project convention use `Key`. The `String` approach also cannot round-trip integer keys: a node built with `Key::int(5)` serializes to `"5"`, and `Key::from("5")` yields `Key::String("5")`, which never matches `Key::Int(5)` in the `BTreeSet<Key>` / `selection::Set` the Context actually stores. So the spec's `.contains(id)` / `.insert(id)` calls also don't compile as written.
- The spec includes Lazy Loading (§5), Renamable Nodes (§6), and Drag-and-Drop reorder (§4.2) as explicitly gated **variants** (`rust,no_check` blocks, not part of the core `Event`/`Part`/`Props` enums in §1.5/§1.6).

```
217	    /// selected keys in collection order.
218	    fn drag_keys(&self) -> Vec<Key> {
219	        let selected_keys = &self.selection().selected_keys;
220	
221	        self.item_keys()
222	            .filter(|key| selected_keys.contains(key))
223	            .cloned()
224	            .collect()
225	    }
```

### 1. **DnD Event Variants in `Event` Enum**

**File:** `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/task-267/crates/ars-components/src/navigation/tabs/mod.rs`

**Lines 177-189:** Tabs defines a single DnD event variant:

```rust
/// User asked to move the given tab to a new index. Reorderable variant
/// (spec §6).
///
/// **Pure notification** — per spec §6.3 the machine does NOT mutate
/// [`Context::tabs`]. Consumers reorder their tab-list source and
/// re-register via [`Event::SetTabs`].
ReorderTab {
    /// The key of the tab being moved.
    tab: Key,

    /// The target zero-based index in the tab list.
    new_index: usize,
},
```

**Key property**: This is a **pure notification** (lines 180-182). The state machine does NOT mutate `Context::tabs` — it's the consumer's responsibility to apply the reorder and re-register via `Event::SetTabs`.

**Transition handler (lines 1019-1020):**
```rust
// ── ReorderTab — pure notification (§6.3) ────────────────
(_, Event::ReorderTab { .. }) => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|_| {})),
```

The transition is a no-op that only produces `context_only(|_| {})` — no state mutations.
