pub fn on_tab_keydown(&self, tab_key: &Key, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
    let (prev_key, next_key) = arrow_pair(self.ctx.orientation, self.ctx.dir);
    let manual = self.ctx.activation_mode == ActivationMode::Manual;

    // §6.4 Ctrl+Arrow reorder. Ctrl+ArrowRight / Ctrl+ArrowDown move
    // forward in DOM order regardless of `dir` (matches Ark UI and
    // keeps index manipulation orthogonal to visual layout).
    if self.props.reorderable && data.ctrl_key {
        let reorder_axis_match = match self.ctx.orientation {
            Orientation::Horizontal => match data.key {
                KeyboardKey::ArrowRight => Some(ReorderStep::Next),
                KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => Some(ReorderStep::Prev),
                _ => None,
            },

            Orientation::Vertical => match data.key {
                KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => Some(ReorderStep::Next),
                KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => Some(ReorderStep::Prev),
                _ => None,
            },
        };

        if let Some(step) = reorder_axis_match {
            if let Some(new_index) = self.next_reorder_index_step(tab_key, step) {
                (self.send)(Event::ReorderTab {
                    tab: tab_key.clone(),
                    new_index,
                });
            }

            return;
        }
    }

    // ... (standard focus/select handling for non-reorder keys)
}
```

**Key methods**:
- **`on_tab_keydown(tab_key, data)`** — lines 1673-1728
  - Dispatches `Event::ReorderTab` when `props.reorderable && data.ctrl_key && axis_match`
  - Uses `next_reorder_index_step()` to compute the new index
  - Returns early so reorder takes precedence over focus navigation

**No pointer drag handler in the agnostic core** — Tabs handles only keyboard-driven reorder. Pointer drag-and-drop (including hover feedback, drop-target validation, indicator positioning) is **100% adapter responsibility**.

**For TreeView**, you'd add:
- `on_node_drag_start(node_key, pointer_type)` → emit announcement, track drag state
- `on_drag_over(target_key, position)` → validate drop, show indicator
- `on_drop(target_key, position)` → dispatch `Event::ReorderNode` / `Event::ReparentNode`

/// Shared callback wrapper for event handler closures in Props structs.

impl<T: ?Sized> Deref for Callback<T> {
    type Target = T;

    fn deref(&self) -> &T {
        &self.0
    }
}

/// Closure signature backing [`Messages::reorder_announce_label`].
///
/// Receives the moved tab's visible label, the new 1-based position,
/// the total tab count, and the active locale, and returns the
/// `LiveAnnouncer` announcement text

pub type ReorderAnnounceLabelFn = dyn Fn(&str, usize, usize, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync;

/// Localizable strings for [`Tabs`](self).
///
/// `close_tab_label` is the accessible name for the close button rendered
/// inside a closable tab (default English template: `"Close {label}"`).
/// `reorder_announce_label` is the `LiveAnnouncer` text emitted by adapters
/// after a keyboard reorder (default: `"{label} moved to position {n} of {total}"`).
/// The agnostic core never invokes `reorder_announce_label` itself —
/// announcing is an adapter concern — but exposing it on [`Messages`]
/// keeps i18n centralized.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Messages {
    /// Builds the accessible name for a tab's close button. See
    /// [`CloseTabLabelFn`] for the closure signature.

    /// Builds the `LiveAnnouncer` text emitted after a keyboard-driven
    /// reorder. See [`ReorderAnnounceLabelFn`] for the closure
    /// signature.
    pub reorder_announce_label: MessageFn<ReorderAnnounceLabelFn>,
}

impl Default for Messages {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            close_tab_label: MessageFn::new(|label: &str, _locale: &Locale| {
                format!("Close {label}")
            }),
            reorder_announce_label: MessageFn::new(
                |label: &str, position: usize, total: usize, _locale: &Locale| {
                    format!("{label} moved to position {position} of {total}")
                },
            ),
        }
    }
}

### 1. **DropPosition Enum (collections.md §10.2, lines 5854–5888)**

```rust
// ars-collections/src/dnd.rs

/// Where an item is being dropped relative to a target item in reading order.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DropPosition {
    /// Before the target item in reading order.
    /// - Vertical list: above the target.
    /// - Horizontal list (LTR): left of the target.
    /// - Horizontal list (RTL): right of the target (inline-start side).
    Before,

    /// After the target item in reading order.
    /// - Vertical list: below the target.
    /// - Horizontal list (LTR): right of the target.
    /// - Horizontal list (RTL): left of the target (inline-end side).
    After,

    /// On top of the target item (e.g., dropping into a folder in a tree).
    On,
}
```

**Lines 5863–5878**: Enum variants with detailed semantics. The `On` variant is explicitly designed for tree reparenting.

### 2. **CollectionDropTarget & Collection DnD Events (collections.md §10.3, lines 5890–5967)**

```rust
// ars-collections/src/dnd.rs

/// A resolved drop target within a collection.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CollectionDropTarget {
    /// The key of the item nearest to the drop point.
    pub key: Key,

    /// Where relative to that item the drop will occur.
    pub position: DropPosition,
}

/// Events fired by collection-level drag-and-drop operations.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum CollectionDndEvent {
    /// Items within the same collection are being reordered.
    ///
    /// `keys`: The keys of the items being moved (may be multiple if selection is dragged).
    /// `target`: The drop target key.
    /// `position`: Where relative to the target the items should be placed.
    Reorder {
        keys: Vec<Key>,
        target: Key,
        position: DropPosition,
    },

    /// Items are being moved from one collection to another.
    ///
    /// `keys`: The keys in the source collection.
    /// `target`: The drop target key in this (destination) collection.
    /// `position`: Where relative to the target.
    Move {
        keys: Vec<Key>,
        target: Key,
        position: DropPosition,
    },

    /// External items (from outside any collection, or from a different data source)
    /// are being inserted into this collection.
    ///
    /// `items`: Serialized drag data for each dragged item.
    /// `target`: The drop target key.
    /// `position`: Where relative to the target.
    Insert {
        items: Vec<DragItem>,
        target: Key,
        position: DropPosition,
    },

    /// A drag operation has started. Fired on the source collection.
    DragStart {
        keys: Vec<Key>,
    },

    /// A drag operation has ended (completed or cancelled).
    DragEnd {
        keys: Vec<Key>,
        /// Whether the drag completed successfully (dropped on valid target).
        success: bool,
    },
}
```

**Lines 5891–5957**: `CollectionDropTarget` (5890–5898), and `CollectionDndEvent` enum with `Reorder`, `Move`, `Insert`, `DragStart`, `DragEnd` variants. For TreeView, **`Reorder` is for sibling reordering, and `Move` (with `DropPosition::On`) is for reparenting into a parent node** (line 908 tree-view.md).

### 7. **CRITICAL RECONCILIATION: ReorderEvent vs CollectionDndEvent**

**INCONSISTENCY IDENTIFIED & RECONCILIATION:**

The TreeView spec defines a **TreeView-specific `ReorderEvent`** (tree-view.md lines 928–938):
```rust
pub struct ReorderEvent {
    pub source_path: Vec<Key>,      // Tree path from root
    pub target_path: Vec<Key>,      // Tree path from root
    pub position: DropPosition,
}
```

But the collections spec defines the **shared `CollectionDndEvent::Reorder`** (collections.md lines 5917–5921):
```rust
Reorder {
    keys: Vec<Key>,                // Flat list of keys
    target: Key,                   // Single target key
    position: DropPosition,
}
```

**Resolution:**
- **`CollectionDndEvent`** is the **low-level collection contract** (flat keys, single target)
- **`ReorderEvent`** is the **TreeView high-level API** (hierarchical paths instead of flat keys)
- **TreeView adapter** must translate:
  - `CollectionDndEvent::Reorder { keys, target, position }` 
  - → `ReorderEvent { source_path: tree_path_of(keys[0]), target_path: tree_path_of(target), position }`
  - For **multiple selected nodes being dragged**, TreeView should only emit one `ReorderEvent` per drag (using the primary/first selected key's path as `source_path`)

**For reparenting (`DropPosition::On`):**
- CollectionDndEvent: `Reorder { keys, target: parent_key, position: On }`
- TreeView: `ReorderEvent { source_path, target_path: path_to_parent, position: On }`

The TreeView spec uses **namespace notation**:

The TreeView spec's use of `drag::Handle` and `drop::Indicator` (lines 908, 914) appears to be **stylistic notation in prose**, not the actual Part enum variant names.

3. **Event contract**: Fire `CollectionDndEvent::Reorder` (siblings) and `CollectionDndEvent::Move` (reparenting) to adapter, which translates to `ReorderEvent` with hierarchical paths
4. **Drop position detection**: Top 25%=Before, bottom 25%=After, middle 50%=Child (On)
5. **Hover-expand**: 500ms delay on collapsed node hover
6. **Keyboard support**: Enter/Space to pick up, arrows to navigate positions, Enter confirm, Escape cancel
7. **Accessibility**: 
   - Items get `aria-roledescription="draggable"` (from messages)
   - Drag handle gets `role="button"`, `aria-label="Drag {item}"`, `tabindex="0"`
   - Items get `aria-grabbed="true/false"` during keyboard DnD
8. **Implement traits**: `DraggableCollection<TreeItem>` (with `allows_drop_on()` returning true for non-leaf nodes) and `DroppableCollection<TreeItem>`
9. **Messages**: Wire `CollectionDndMessages` for announcements
10. **Part naming**: Use bare names `DragHandle` and `DropIndicator`, not namespaced notation

> AGENT

Good instinct to check. Here's what I found:

**The `Draggable`/`DroppableCollection` traits + types are already done** — implemented in **#549 (closed)** in `ars-collections`, explicitly "to enable automatic DnD behavior for Listbox, GridList, Table, and TreeView." Same for the drag/drop interaction machines, keyboard-DnD protocol, and announcements (#159/#160/#161, all closed in `ars-interactions`).

**Implementing those traits *for TreeView* is an adapter-layer concern**, for two concrete reasons:
- `DraggableCollection::selection(&self) -> &selection::State` is a **required** method. `TreeCollection` doesn't own selection state (it lives in the component's `Context`), so the bare collection can't implement it — the implementor must bundle collection + live selection + do DOM pointer/keyboard hit-testing. That binding is exactly what the adapter does (via `use_drag`/`use_drop`).
- There are already **separate open tasks** for this: **#366 (TreeView Leptos adapter)** and **#509 (TreeView Dioxus adapter)**, under adapter epics #8/#9. This task's epic (#223) explicitly scopes adapters *out*.

So the trait impls + hit-testing + 500ms hover-expand + `use_drag`/`use_drop` wiring all belong to #366/#509. What an *agnostic core* can own is only the thin semantic surface: the `ReorderEvent` type, `dnd_enabled`/`on_reorder` props, `DragHandle`/`DropIndicator` parts + their attrs, `aria-roledescription`/`aria-grabbed`, the drag-state transitions, and `Effect::Reorder`.

That reframes the scope choice, since your earlier "Core + DnD" answer predated this layering being clear:

The DnD *collection traits/types* (`DropPosition`,\n   `CollectionDndEvent`, `Draggable/DroppableCollection`) already exist from **#549 (closed)** in\n   `ars-collections`. *Implementing* those traits for TreeView requires the live `selection::State`\n   (the required `DraggableCollection::selection()` method) + DOM pointer/keyboard hit-testing +\n   500ms hover-expand + `use_drag`/`use_drop` wiring — all **adapter-layer**, tracked by the\n   separate open tasks **#366 (TreeView Leptos adapter)** / **#509 (TreeView Dioxus adapter)** under\n   adapter epics #8/#9 (epic #223 scopes adapters out). So #267 owns only the agnostic semantic\n   surface: `ReorderEvent`, `dnd_enabled`/`on_reorder`, `DragHandle`/`DropIndicator` parts + attrs,\n   `aria-roledescription`/`aria-grabbed`, drag-state events, and `Effect::Reorder`. `nodes()` / `keys()` are **visible-only**\n    (iterate `visible_indices`).\n  - `Node<T>` **fields**: `key: Key`, `value: Option<T>`, `text_value: String`, `level: usize`,\n    `has_children: bool`, `parent_key: Option<Key>`, `is_expanded: Option<bool>`, `node_type`, `index`.\n  - `Key`: `Key::from(&str|String)`, `Key::int(u64)`, `to_string()`, `Default`; **no `Borrow<str>`**.\n  - `selection::{Set, State, Mode, Behavior}`: `Set::contains(&Key)`, `State::new(mode, behavior)`,\n    `State::select(key: Key)->State`, `State::deselect(&Key)->State`, field `selected_keys: Set`.\n  - `dnd::{DropPosition (Before|After|On), CollectionDropTarget { key, position }, CollectionDndEvent}`.\n- `ars-core`: `Machine` trait (`type State/Event/Context/Props/Messages/Effect/Api`,\n  `init(&Props,&Env,&Messages)`, `transition`, `connect`); `TransitionPlan::{to,new,context_only,\n  apply,with_effect,with_named_effect,cancel_effect,then}`; `Bindable::{controlled,uncontrolled,get,set}`;\n  `AttrMap::{new,set,set_bool}`; `HtmlAttr` / `AriaAttr`; `ComponentIds::from_id`; `MessageFn`;\n  `ComponentMessages`; `Callback<T>` (Deref-call); `EffectName`; `no_cleanup`.\n- `ars-interactions`: `KeyboardEventData`, `KeyboardKey` (re-exported via `ars_core::KeyboardKey`), `DragItem`.\n\n## Prior art to mirror exactly\n\n- `crates/ars-components/src/navigation/accordion/mod.rs` — `Bindable<BTreeSet<Key>>` expand/collapse,\n  `Part` variants with `Key` fields, `Effect::FocusFocusedItem`, inline `snapshot_attrs` helper +\n  `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.\n- `crates/ars-components/src/navigation/tabs/mod.rs` + `tabs/tests.rs` — roving focus\n  `Effect::FocusFocusedTab` emitted on Focus{Next,Prev,First,Last}; # Task #267 — Implement TreeView agnostic core (+ DnD reorder variant)

## Context

GitHub issue #267 (epic #223, "Agnostic navigation components") asks for the framework-agnostic
core of `TreeView`: a hierarchical, keyboard-navigable tree implementing the WAI-ARIA tree pattern
(`role="tree"`/`treeitem"`/`group"`) with expand/collapse, single/multiple selection, roving
focus + keyboard navigation, typeahead, and `aria-*` wiring. The data model is `TreeCollection`
from `ars-collections` (dependency #83, already merged/closed). Adapter components (Leptos/Dioxus)
are out of scope.

The user explicitly chose, for this task:
1. **Identity type = `Key`** (not the spec's `String`), aligning with every sibling component
   (Accordion `item_key: Key`, Tabs `tab_key: Key`) and the project-wide convention enforced
   across all 112 components. The written spec's `String`-based API is **stale** (predates that
   sweep) and is also buggy: a node built with `Key::int(5)` serializes to `"5"`, and
   `Key::from("5")` yields `Key::String("5")`, which never matches `Key::Int(5)` in the
   `BTreeSet<Key>` / `selection::Set` the Context actually stores. The spec's `.contains(id)` /
   `.insert(id)` calls also do not compile against `BTreeSet<Key>` (`Key: !Borrow<str>`).
   **We deviate to `Key` and update the spec to match.**
2. **Scope = everything that belongs in the agnostic core layer**, including the DnD reorder
   variant's agnostic surface (§4.2). The DnD *collection traits/types* (`DropPosition`,
   `CollectionDndEvent`, `Draggable/DroppableCollection`) already exist from **#549 (closed)** in
   `ars-collections`. *Implementing* those traits for TreeView requires the live `selection::State`
   (the required `DraggableCollection::selection()` method) + DOM pointer/keyboard hit-testing +
   500ms hover-expand + `use_drag`/`use_drop` wiring — all **adapter-layer**, tracked by the
   separate open tasks **#366 (TreeView Leptos adapter)** / **#509 (TreeView Dioxus adapter)** under
   adapter epics #8/#9 (epic #223 scopes adapters out). So #267 owns only the agnostic semantic
   surface: `ReorderEvent`, `dnd_enabled`/`on_reorder`, `DragHandle`/`DropIndicator` parts + attrs,
   `aria-roledescription`/`aria-grabbed`, drag-state events, and `Effect::Reorder`. Lazy-loading
   (§5) and rename (§6) variants remain separate follow-up tasks.

Spec is authoritative; where it drifts from the implemented dependency APIs or the cross-component
conventions, we fix the spec in this same PR (per `spec/CLAUDE.md` + root CLAUDE.md "Spec/code
mismatch resolution").

  - `selection::{Set, State, Mode, Behavior}`: `Set::contains(&Key)`, `State::new(mode, behavior)`,

  `Part` variants with `Key` fields, `Effect::FocusFocusedItem`, inline `snapshot_attrs` helper +
  `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/ars-components/src/navigation/tabs/mod.rs` + `tabs/tests.rs` — roving focus
  `Effect::FocusFocusedTab` emitted on Focus{Next,Prev,First,Last}; reorder as a notification
  (`reorderable` prop, `on_*_keydown` dispatch, pure-notification transition), separate `tests.rs`.
- `crates/ars-components/src/navigation/*/key_token.rs` (`super::key_token::dom_safe_key_token`) for
  DOM-id-safe key tokens via `ComponentIds::item`.

## Design decisions (spec reconciliations — all land in this PR)

1. **`Key` identity** everywhere (events, `Api` params, `Part` fields). Keep the spec's parameter
   name `node_id` but type it `&Key` / `Key` (reads as "the node's id", consistent with
   `feedback_use_key_not_string` which permits Key for item IDs).
2. **Roving-focus effect**: add `Effect::FocusFocusedNode`, emitted on `FocusNode/Next/Prev/First/
   Last/Parent`, `TypeaheadSearch`, and the `Idle→Focused` keyboard bootstrap. This is the
   established adapter-resolved-focus mechanism (Tabs/Accordion) and satisfies the issue's
   "live node focus … must be adapter-resolved" note. The spec §1.5 omits it → sync spec.
3. **`ExpandAll` over all nodes**: `TreeCollection::nodes()` is visible-only, so the spec's
   `nodes().filter(has_children)` cannot reach expandable nodes under collapsed parents. Add
   `TreeCollection::all_keys()` (and `all_nodes()`) read-only accessors to `ars-collections`
   (iterate `all_nodes`), with unit tests + a one-line sync in `spec/foundation/06-collections.md`.
   `ExpandAll` uses `all_keys()` filtered by `node.has_children`.
4. **Keyboard handler**: add `Api::on_node_keydown(&Key, &KeyboardEventData)` mapping §3.2 keys to
   events (Arrow logic uses logical/expand-collapse semantics, **not** RTL-swapped per §3.3).
   `*` expands the focused node's expandable siblings (computed via `parent_key` + `children_of`,
   emitting `ExpandNode` per sibling). Spec §1.6 omits this handler → sync spec.
5. **`Messages` must derive `PartialEq`** (Context derives PartialEq and holds `messages: Messages`).
   Spec §4.1 omits it → fix.
6. **DnD reconciliation** (§4 / `06-collections.md` §10.8) — implement **all DnD logic that is pure
   data-model computation** in the core; defer only DOM-bound pieces. The split:
   - **Agnostic core owns** (this task): canonical **`Part::DragHandle { node_id: Key }`** and
     **`Part::DropIndicator`** (bare names per collections + listbox/gridlist/table; the spec's
     `drag::Handle`/`drop::Indicator` prose is notation → fix). `DropPosition::On` for
     reparent/drop-as-child (spec §4.2 "Child" prose → "On"). Drag-state machine in `Context`
     (`dragging: Option<Key>`, `drop_target: Option<CollectionDropTarget>`, `pending_reorder`).
     Events: `DragStart(Key)`, `DragOver(CollectionDropTarget)` (adapter-resolved pointer hover),
     `DragMoveNext`/`DragMovePrev` (**keyboard** stepping through valid drop slots — pure
     collection logic), `Drop`, `CancelDrag`. **Drop-validity logic** in the core: reject dropping a
     node onto itself or any of its descendants (cycle check via `parent_key` walk), and `On` only
     where the target may parent. **Keyboard DnD protocol** in `on_drag_handle_keydown`:
     Enter/Space pickup → `DragStart`; Arrow Up/Down → `DragMovePrev/Next`; Enter → `Drop`;
     Escape → `CancelDrag`. `ReorderEvent` computation (walk `parent_key` for source/target paths).
     Attrs: `drag_handle_attrs`, `drop_indicator_attrs` (`data-drop-position`, `data-drop-target`,
     `aria-hidden`), and item attrs gain `aria-roledescription`/`aria-grabbed`/`data-ars-dragging`
     when `dnd_enabled`. `Effect::Reorder` named effect; `Api::reorder_event()` / `drop_target()`
     accessors so the adapter can render the indicator and fire the callback.
   - **Adapter owns** (#366/#509, deferred): pointer hit-testing / drop-position-from-pointer-Y
     (top25/bottom25/middle50 → Before/On/After), 500ms hover-expand **timer** (adapter sends
     `ExpandNode`), `use_drag`/`use_drop` + `DataTransfer`/drag-image DOM wiring,
     `Draggable/DroppableCollection` trait impls (require live `selection::State` — adapter bundles
     it), and `LiveAnnouncer` announcements. Noted in spec.
   - Reorder completion: `Props.on_reorder: Option<Callback<ReorderEvent>>`, invoked by the adapter
     on the named `Effect::Reorder` (convention match with `Effect::CheckedChange`); core computes
     `ReorderEvent` into `Context.pending_reorder`.
   - **`ReorderEvent { source_path: Vec<Key>, target_path: Vec<Key>, position: DropPosition }`** per
     tree-view §4.2 (single dragged item / path-based). Spec reconciliation note: `CollectionDndEvent`
     is the low-level collection contract (flat keys); `ReorderEvent` is the TreeView surface.
   - The core does **not** mutate `ctx.items` on `Drop` (pure-notification, like Tabs); the consumer
     applies the reorder and re-supplies props.

## Files

### New — component
- `crates/ars-components/src/navigation/tree_view/mod.rs` — full machine: `TreeItem`, `Context`,
  `Props` (`#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, ars_core::HasId)]`, + `dnd_enabled`, `on_reorder`),
  `State` (Idle/Focused), `Event` (core + DnD), `Effect` (`FocusFocusedNode`, `Reorder`), `Machine`,
  `Part` (`#[derive(ComponentPart)] #[scope="tree-view"]`: Root, Branch, BranchControl,

60	/// # Stack safety
61	///
62	/// Tree depth is capped at [`MAX_TREE_DEPTH`] (32 levels). This limit is
63	/// intentionally conservative to stay within the default WASM stack size
64	/// (typically 64 KiB–1 MiB) where each recursive `insert_item` frame
65	/// consumes stack space. The constant is checked at insertion time and
66	/// panics immediately if violated, rather than risking a silent stack
67	/// overflow at runtime.
68	pub struct TreeCollection<T> {
69	    /// All nodes, including those inside collapsed subtrees.
70	    all_nodes: Vec<Node<T>>,
71	
72	    /// Subset of flat indices that are currently visible (not inside a
73	    /// collapsed ancestor).
74	    visible_indices: Vec<usize>,
75	
76	    /// Map from Key to flat index in `all_nodes`.
77	    key_to_index: IndexMap<Key, usize, DefaultHashBuilder>,
78	
79	    /// Set of keys whose subtrees are currently expanded.
80	    expanded_keys: BTreeSet<Key>,
81	
82	    /// Cached `all_nodes` index of the first visible focusable item.
83	    first_focusable_visible: Option<usize>,
84	
85	    /// Cached `all_nodes` index of the last visible focusable item.
86	    last_focusable_visible: Option<usize>,
87	}
88	
89	impl<T: Clone> Clone for TreeCollection<T> {
90	    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
91	        Self {
92	            all_nodes: self.all_nodes.clone(),
93	            visible_indices: self.visible_indices.clone(),
94	            key_to_index: self.key_to_index.clone(),
95	            expanded_keys: self.expanded_keys.clone(),
96	            first_focusable_visible: self.first_focusable_visible,
97	            last_focusable_visible: self.last_focusable_visible,
98	        }
99	    }
100	}
101	
102	/// Manual `Debug` avoids requiring `T: Debug`. Prints node counts only,
103	/// since the payload `T` is opaque to the machine layer.
104	impl<T> Debug for TreeCollection<T> {
105	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
106	        f.debug_struct("TreeCollection")
107	            .field("total_nodes", &self.all_nodes.len())
108	            .field("visible_nodes", &self.visible_indices.len())
109	            .finish()
110	    }
111	}

113	/// Structural equality: two tree collections are equal when they contain the
114	/// same nodes in the same order with the same hierarchy and expansion state.
115	/// Extends `Node::PartialEq` (which compares key, type, text, value) with
116	/// hierarchy fields (`level`, `parent_key`) that are significant for trees.
117	impl<T: Clone + PartialEq> PartialEq for TreeCollection<T> {
118	    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
119	        self.all_nodes.len() == other.all_nodes.len()
120	            && self.expanded_keys == other.expanded_keys
121	            && self
122	                .all_nodes
123	                .iter()
124	                .zip(other.all_nodes.iter())
125	                .all(|(a, b)| a == b && a.level == b.level && a.parent_key == b.parent_key)
126	    }
127	}
128	
129	/// Maximum nesting depth for tree items. Enforced during construction to
130	/// guarantee WASM stack safety — the default WASM stack (64 KiB–1 MiB)
131	/// cannot support unbounded recursion.
132	const MAX_TREE_DEPTH: usize = 32;
133	
134	impl<T> TreeCollection<T> {
135	    /// Compute which flat indices are visible given the current expansion set,
136	    /// along with cached first/last focusable visible indices.
137	    fn compute_visible(all_nodes: &[Node<T>]) -> (Vec<usize>, Option<usize>, Option<usize>) {
138	        let mut visible = Vec::with_capacity(all_nodes.len());
139	
140	        let mut first_focusable = None;
141	
142	        let mut last_focusable = None;
143	
144	        let mut skip_until_level = None::<usize>;
145	
146	        for node in all_nodes {
147	            // If we're skipping a collapsed subtree, check whether we've
148	            // exited it (returned to the same or higher level).
149	            if let Some(skip_level) = skip_until_level {
150	                if node.level <= skip_level {
151	                    skip_until_level = None;
152	                } else {
153	                    continue; // still inside a collapsed subtree
154	                }
155	            }
156	
157	            visible.push(node.index);
158	
159	            if node.is_focusable() {
160	                if first_focusable.is_none() {
161	                    first_focusable = Some(node.index);
162	                }
163	
164	                last_focusable = Some(node.index);
165	            }
166	
167	            // If this node has children and is not expanded, skip children.
168	            if node.has_children && node.is_expanded != Some(true) {
169	                skip_until_level = Some(node.level);
170	            }
171	        }
172	
173	        (visible, first_focusable, last_focusable)
174	    }
175	}
176

178	    fn default() -> Self {
179	        Self::new([])
180	    }
181	}

189

603	    /// Returns `true` when the node at `key` currently has at least one
604	    /// child (i.e. it is a branch, not a leaf), or `false` when the
605	    /// node is a leaf **or** the key is unknown.
606	    ///
607	    /// Mirrors the [`Node::has_children`] field. Available without the
608	    /// `T: Clone` bound that `Collection::get(&node).has_children` would
609	    /// require, so callers operating on a generic `T: CollectionItem`
610	    /// (such as [`MutableTreeData`]'s mutation methods) can detect
611	    /// leaf↔branch transitions without paying for `Clone`.
612	    ///
613	    /// [`Node::has_children`]: crate::node::Node::has_children
614	    /// [`MutableTreeData`]: crate::mutable::MutableTreeData
615	    #[must_use]
616	    pub fn has_children(&self, key: &Key) -> bool {
617	        self.key_to_index
618	            .get(key)
619	            .is_some_and(|&i| self.all_nodes[i].has_children)
620	    }
621	
622	    /// Get the **visible** iteration index of a node by key, or `None`
623	    /// when the key is unknown **or** the node sits inside a collapsed
624	    /// ancestor (and is therefore hidden from `Collection::nodes` /
625	    /// `Collection::get_by_index`).
626	    ///
627	    /// Adapters driving DOM reconciliation should consume visible indices
628	    /// — the flat DFS index returned by [`flat_index_of`](Self::flat_index_of)
629	    /// does not correspond to any DOM position when a node is hidden.
630	    pub fn visible_index_of(&self, key: &Key) -> Option<usize> {
631	        let flat = self.flat_index_of(key)?;
632	        // `visible_indices` is sorted ascending (it preserves DFS order),
633	        // so binary search is correct and faster than a linear scan for
634	        // large trees.
635	        self.visible_indices.binary_search(&flat).ok()
636	    }
637

639	    ///

642	    /// called from generic contexts (such as `MutableTreeData`'s mutation
643	    /// methods, which only require `T: CollectionItem`).
644	    pub fn visible_keys(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Key> {
645	        self.visible_indices.iter().map(|&i| &self.all_nodes[i].key)

988:#### 1.8.3 MutableTreeData
1015:`Collection::nodes` and `Collection::get_by_index` iterate the **visible** subset of a tree — items inside a collapsed ancestor are excluded. 1952	impl<T> TreeCollection<T> {
1953	    /// Compute which flat indices are visible given the current expansion set,
1954	    /// along with cached first/last focusable visible indices.
1955	    fn compute_visible(
1956	        all_nodes: &[Node<T>],
1957	    ) -> (Vec<usize>, Option<usize>, Option<usize>) {
1958	        let mut visible = Vec::with_capacity(all_nodes.len());
1959	        let mut first_focusable = None;
1960	        let mut last_focusable = None;
1961	        let mut skip_until_level: Option<usize> = None;
1962	
1963	        for node in all_nodes {
1964	            // If we're skipping a collapsed subtree, check whether we've
1965	            // exited it (returned to the same or higher level).
1966	            if let Some(skip_level) = skip_until_level {
1967	                if node.level <= skip_level {
1968	                    skip_until_level = None;
1969	                } else {
1970	                    continue; // still inside a collapsed subtree
1971	                }
1972	            }
1973	
1974	            visible.push(node.index);
1975	
1976	            if node.is_focusable() {
1977	                if first_focusable.is_none() {
1978	                    first_focusable = Some(node.index);
1979	                }
1980	                last_focusable = Some(node.index);
1981	            }
1982	
1983	            // If this node has children and is not expanded, skip children.
1984	            if node.has_children && node.is_expanded != Some(true) {
1985	                skip_until_level = Some(node.level);
1986	            }
1987	        }
1988	        (visible, first_focusable, last_focusable)
1989	    }
1990	}
1991	
1992	impl<T: Clone> Default for TreeCollection<T> {
1993	    fn default() -> Self {
1994	        Self::new([])
1995	    }
1996	}

1	//! Shared navigation key encoding helpers.
2	
3	use alloc::{format, string::String};
4	use core::fmt::Write as _;
5	
6	use ars_collections::Key;
7	
8	/// Returns a DOM-id-safe token for a component item key.
9	pub(crate) fn dom_safe_key_token(key: &Key) -> String {
10	    match key {
11	        Key::Int(value) => format!("i-{value}"),
12	
13	        #[cfg(feature = "uuid")]
14	        Key::Uuid(value) => format!("u-{value}"),
15	
16	        Key::String(value) => {
17	            let mut token = String::from("s-");
18	
19	            for byte in value.as_bytes() {
20	                write!(token, "{byte:02x}").expect("writing to a String cannot fail");
21	            }
22	
23	            token
24	        }
25	    }
26	}

}\n}\n\n/// Direction used by relative focus and keyboard drag-slot stepping.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy)]\nenum Direction {\n    Next,\n    Prev,\n}\n\n/// Build a focus transition that moves the indicator to `key` and emits the\n/// scroll-into-view intent.\nfn focus_plan(key: Key) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {\n    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)\n        .apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n            ctx.focused_node = Some(key);\n            ctx.focus_visible = true;\n        })\n        .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::ScrollFocusedIntoView))\n}\n\n/// The visible keys (DFS order) under the current expansion set.\nfn visible_keys(ctx: &Context) -> Vec<Key> {\n    ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(ctx.expanded.get())\n}\n\n/// Resolve the relative focus target, wrapping at the ends.\nfn focus_relative(ctx: &Context, direction: Direction) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>> {\n    let visible = visible_keys(ctx);\n    if visible.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let target = match &ctx.focused_node {\n        Some(current) => match visible.iter().position(|key| key == current) {\n            Some(pos) => match direction {\n                Direction::Next => visible.get(pos + 1).or_else(|| visible.first()),\n                Direction::Prev => {\n                    if pos > 0 {\n                        visible.get(pos - 1)\n                    } else {\n                        visible.last()\n                    }\n                }\n            },\n            // Focused node not in the visible set (collapsed ancestor): start\n            // from the appropriate end.\n            None => match direction {\n                Direction::Next => visible.first(),\n                Direction::Prev => visible.last(),\n            },\n target.cloned().map(focus_plan)\n}\n\n/// Find the next visible node whose label starts with `ch` (case-insensitive),\n/// searching after the focused node and wrapping around.\nfn typeahead_target(ctx: &Context, ch: char) -> Option<Key> {\n    let needle = ch.to_lowercase().next().unwrap_or(ch);\n    let visible = visible_keys(ctx);\n    if visible.is_empty() {\n        return visible\n        .iter()\n        .cycle()\n        .skip(start)\n        .take(visible.len())\n        .find(|key| {\n            ctx.items\n                .get(key)\n                .and_then(|node| node.text_value.chars().next())\n                .map(|first| first.to_lowercase().next().unwrap_or(first))\n                == Some(needle)\n        })\n        .cloned()\n}\n\n/// The ordered list of valid keyboard drop slots for the dragged node.\n///\n/// For every visible node that is neither the dragged node nor a descendant of\n/// it (which would create a cycle), three slots are produced in reading order:\n/// `Before`, `On` (reparent), then `After`. Keyboard stepping cycles through\n/// this list.\nfn valid_drop_slots(ctx: &Context, dragging: &Key) -> Vec<CollectionDropTarget> {\n    let mut slots = Vec::new();\n    for key in visible_keys(ctx) {\n        if &key == dragging || is_descendant(&ctx.items, dragging, &key) {\n            continue;\n        }\n        for position in [DropPosition::Before, DropPosition::On, DropPosition::After] the next/previous valid slot.\nfn drag_step(\n    ctx: &Context,\n    props: &Props,\n    direction: Direction,\n) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>> {\n    if !props.dnd_enabled {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let dragging = ctx.dragging.as_ref()?;\n    let slots = valid_drop_slots(ctx, dragging);\n    if slots.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let next = match ctx\n        .drop_target\n        .as_ref()\n        .and_then(|current| slots.iter().position(|slot| slot == current))\n    {\n        Some(pos) => match direction {\n            Direction::Next => (pos + 1) % slots.len(),\n            Direction::Prev => (pos + slots.len() - 1) % slots.len(),\n        },\n        None => match direction {\n            Direction::Next => 0,\n            Direction::Prev => slots.len() - 1,\n        },\n    };\n\n    let target = slots[next].clone();\n    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n        ctx.drop_target = Some(target);\n    }))\n}\n\n/// Whether `candidate` is `ancestor` itself or sits below it in the tree.\nfn is_descendant(items: &TreeCollection<TreeItem>, ancestor: &Key, candidate: &Key) -> bool {\n    let mut current = items.get(candidate).and_then(|node| node.parent_key.clone());\n    while let Some(parent) = current {\n        if &parent == ancestor {\n            return true;\n        }\n        current = items.get(&parent).and_then(|node| node.parent_key.clone());\n    }\n    false\n}\n\n/// Whether dropping the dragged node at `target` is valid: never onto itself or\n/// any of its descendants (which would create a cycle).\nfn is_valid_drop(\n    items: &TreeCollection<TreeItem>,\n    dragging: &Key,\n    target: &CollectionDropTarget,\n) -> bool {\n    &target.key != dragging && !is_descendant(items, dragging, &target.key)\n}\n\n/// The path of keys from the root down to `key` (inclusive).\nfn path_to(items: &TreeCollection<TreeItem>, key: &Key) -> Vec<Key> {\n    let mut path = Vec::new();\n    let mut current = Some(key.clone());\n    while let Some(node_key) = current {\n        current = items.get(&node_key).and_then(|node| node.parent_key.clone());\n        path.push(node_key);\n    }\n    path.reverse();\n    path\n}\n\n/// Build the named reorder effect that invokes [`Props::on_reorder`].\nfn reorder_effect(event: ReorderEvent) -> PendingEffect<Machine> {\n    PendingEffect::new(Effect::Reorder, move |_ctx: &Context, props: &Props, _send| {\n        if let Some(callback) = &props.on_reorder {\n node_dom_id(ids: &ComponentIds, key: &Key) -> String {\n    ids.item(\"node\", &dom_safe_key_token(key))\n}\n\n/// Connect API for the [`TreeView`](self) component.\npub struct Api<'a> {\n    /// Current machine state.\n    state: &'a State,\n\n    /// Current context.\n    ctx: &'a Context,\n\n    /// Current props.\n    props: &'a Props,\n\n    /// Event dispatcher.\n    send: &'a dyn /// Whether a node is selected.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_node_selected(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.selected.get().contains(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Whether a node is expanded.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_node_expanded(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.expanded.get().contains(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Whether a node holds the focus indicator.\n #[must_use]\n    pub fn is_dragging(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.dragging.as_ref() == Some(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// The current resolved drop target during an active drag, if attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::MultiSelectable), \"true\");\n        }\n\n        if let Some(focused) = &self.ctx.focused_node {\n            attrs.set(\n   /// Handle focus on the tree root.\n    pub fn on_root_focus(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::Focus { is_keyboard: false });\n    }\n\n    /// Handle blur on the tree root.\n    pub fn on_root_blur(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::Blur);\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for a branch node (expandable, has children).\n    ///\n    /// `aria-expanded` is emitted when the node has real fn leaf_text_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        part_only_attrs(Part::LeafText)\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for a node's drag handle (drag-and-drop surface).\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn children).\n    fn is_branch(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.items.get(node_id).is_some_and(|node| {\n            node.has_children\n                || node\n attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-dragging\"), true);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {\n    type Part = Part;\n\n    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap self.branch_control_attrs(node_id),\n            Part::BranchIndicator { ref node_id } => self.branch_indicator_attrs(node_id),\n            Part::BranchText => self.branch_text_attrs(),\n            Part::BranchContent { ref node_id } => self.branch_content_attrs(node_id),\n            Part::Leaf { ref node_id } => self.leaf_attrs(node_id),\n            Part::LeafText => self.leaf_text_attrs(),\n            Part::DragHandle { ref node_id } => self.drag_handle_attrs(node_id),\n            Part::DropIndicator => self\n                .ctx\n                .drop_target\n                .as_ref()\n                .map_or_else(|| part_only_attrs(Part::DropIndicator), |target| {\n                    self.drop_indicator_attrs(target)\n                }),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Render the canonical `\"true\"`/`\"false\"` ARIA boolean token.\nconst fn bool_token(value: bool) -> &'static str {\n    if value { \"true\" } else { \"false\" }\n}\n\n/// Build an `AttrMap` carrying only a part's scope/part data attributes.\nfn part_only_attrs(part: Part) -> AttrMap {\n    let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n    let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = part.data_attrs();\n    attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val).set(part_attr, part_val);\n    attrs\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nfn snapshot_attrs(attrs: &AttrMap) -> String {\n    use core::fmt::Write as _;\n\n    let mut entries = attrs.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();\n    entries.sort_by_key(|(attr, _)| attr.to_string());\n\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    for (attr, value) in entries {\n        let _ = writeln!(&mut out, \"{}={}\", attr, value.as_str().unwrap_or(\"<reactive>\"));\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests;\n"
}

1	//! Shared helpers for spec-conformance tests.
2	//!
3	//! Per-component tests call [`assert_anatomy`] with the expected scope and
4	//! the expected `(part, kebab-name)` list. The helper checks every facet
5	//! of the `ComponentPart` contract that the spec's §3 anatomy table
6	//! declares:
7	//!
8	//! 1. `Part::scope()` matches the spec's `data-ars-scope` token.
9	//! 2. `Part::all()` produces exactly the declared parts in the declared
10	//!    order.
11	//! 3. Every declared part round-trips through `Part::name()` with the
12	//!    declared kebab-case token.
13	//! 4. `Part::ROOT` equals the first declared part (workspace convention:
14	//!    every `Part` enum's first variant is `Root`).
15	
16	use ars_core::ComponentPart;
17	
18	/// Asserts that the supplied `Part` enum matches the spec's anatomy
19	/// declaration.
20	///
21	/// `expected_scope` is the `#[scope = "..."]` token the spec puts on the
22	/// `data-ars-scope` attribute. `expected_parts` is the ordered list of
23	/// `(part, kebab-name)` pairs from the spec's §3 anatomy table.
24	pub(crate) fn assert_anatomy<P>(expected_scope: &'static str, expected_parts: &[(P, &'static str)])
25	where
26	    P: ComponentPart + core::fmt::Debug + PartialEq,
27	{
28	    assert_eq!(
29	        P::scope(),
30	        expected_scope,
31	        "Part::scope() must match spec §3 anatomy",
32	    );
33	
34	    let actual = P::all();
35	
36	    let actual_names = actual.iter().map(ComponentPart::name).collect::<Vec<_>>();
37	
38	    let expected_names = expected_parts
39	        .iter()
40	        .map(|(_, name)| *name)
41	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
42	
43	    assert_eq!(
44	        actual_names, expected_names,
45	        "Part::all() name list must equal spec §3 anatomy column \
46	         (scope = {expected_scope:?})",
47	    );
48	
49	    assert_eq!(
50	        actual.len(),
51	        expected_parts.len(),
52	        "Part::all() length must match the number of spec §3 anatomy rows",
53	    );
54	
55	    for (actual_part, (expected_part, expected_name)) in actual.iter().zip(expected_parts) {
56	        assert_eq!(
57	            actual_part.name(),
58	            *expected_name,
59	            "Part {actual_part:?} must produce kebab-name {expected_name:?}",
60	        );
61	        assert_eq!(
62	            actual_part, expected_part,
63	            "Part::all()[i] must equal the expected part value",
64	        );
65	    }
66	
67	    if let Some((first_expected, _)) = expected_parts.first() {
68	        assert_eq!(
69	            &P::ROOT,
70	            first_expected,
71	            "Workspace convention: Part::ROOT (the first variant) must \
72	             equal the first spec-declared part",
73	        );
74	    }
75	}
76

label: label.to_string(),\n        ..TreeItem::default()\n    }\n}\n\nfn leaf(key: u64, label: &str) -> TreeItemConfig<TreeItem> {\n    TreeItemConfig {\n        key: Key::int(key),\n TreeItemConfig<TreeItem> {\n    TreeItemConfig {\n        key: Key::int(key),\n        text_value: label.to_string(),\n        value,\n        children: Vec::new(),\n        default_expanded: false,\n    }\n}\n\nfn branch(\n    key: u64,\n    label: &str,\n    expanded: bool,\n    children: Vec<TreeItemConfig<TreeItem>>,\n) -> TreeItemConfig<TreeItem> {\n    TreeItemConfig {\n        key: Key::int(key),\n        text_value: label.to_string(),\n        value: item(label),\n        children,\n        default_expanded: expanded,\n    }\n}\n\n/// ```text\n/// 1: Fruits (expanded)\n///   2: Apple\n///   3: Banana\n/// 4: Vegetables (collapsed)\n///   5: Carrot\n///   6: Daikon\n/// 7: Grains\n/// ```\nfn sample_items() -> TreeCollection<TreeItem> {\n    TreeCollection::new(vec![\n        branch(1, \"Fruits\", true, vec![leaf(2, \"Apple\"), leaf(3, \"Banana\")]),\n        branch(\n            4,\n            \"Vegetables\",\n            false,\n            vec![leaf(5, \"Carrot\"), leaf(6, \"Daikon\")],\n        ),\n        leaf(7, \"Grains\"),\n    ])\n}\n\nfn props() -> Props {\n    Props::new().id(\"tree\").items(sample_items())\n}\n\nfn service(props: Props) -> character: None,\n        code: key.as_w3c_str().to_owned(),\n        shift_key: false,\n        ctrl_key: false,\n        alt_key: false,\n        meta_key: false,\n        repeat: false,\n        is_composing: false,\n    }\n}\n\nfn printable(ch: char) -> KeyboardEventData {\n    KeyboardEventData {\n        key: KeyboardKey::Unidentified,\n        character: Some(ch),\n        code: String::new(),\n        shift_key: false,\n        ctrl_key: false,\n        alt_key: false,\n        meta_key: false,\n        repeat: false,\n        is_composing: false,\n    }\n}\n\ntype Recorder = RefCell<Vec<Event>>;\n\nfn record(recorder: &Recorder, event: Event) {\n    recorder.borrow_mut().push(event);\n}\n\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Init\n// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn init_uncontrolled_uses_defaults() {\n    let mut expanded = BTreeSet::new();\n    expanded.insert(key(1));\n\n    let service = service(\n        props()\n            .default_selected(selection::Set::Single(key(2)))\n            .default_expanded(expanded.clone()),\n    );\n\n    assert!(!service.context().selected.is_controlled());\n    assert!(!service.context().expanded.is_controlled());\n    assert_eq!(service.context().expanded.get(), &expanded);\n    assert!(service.context().selected.get().contains(&key(2)));\n    assert_eq!(service.context().focused_node, None);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn init_controlled_uses_props() {\n    let service = service(\n        props()\n            .selected(selection::Set::Single(key(3)))\n  drop(service.send(Event::ExpandNode(key(4))));\n    assert!(service.context().expanded.get().contains(&key(4)));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn collapse_node_removes_from_expanded() {\n    let mut service = drop(service.send(Event::ToggleNode(key(4))));\n    assert!(service.context().expanded.get().contains(&key(4)));\n\n    drop(service.send(Event::ToggleNode(key(4))));\n drop(service.send(Event::ExpandAll));\n\n    // Both expandable branches (Fruits, Vegetables) must be expanded, even\n    // though Vegetables started collapsed (its descendants were hidden).\n    let > AGENT

Most tests pass. Three logic failures share one root cause: the component's `ctx.expanded` is seeded only from `props.default_expanded` (empty in my tests), ignoring the collection's per-node `default_expanded` (Fruits). That makes a `TreeItemConfig { default_expanded: true }` silently non-expanded — a pit-of-failure. I'll seed initial expansion from the collection's default-expanded nodes too (union with `props.default_expanded`) for the uncontrolled case. Let me check `Node.is_expanded` is the right signal, then fix `init`.

Ignored unless\n    /// `Props::dnd_enabled`.\n    DragStart(Key),\n    /// Set the resolved drop target (adapter pointer hit-testing). Ignored when\n    /// no drag is active or the target is invalid (self / descendant).\n    DragOver(CollectionDropTarget),\n    /// Step the keyboard drop target to the next valid slot.\n    DragMoveNext,\n    /// Step the keyboard drop target to the previous valid slot.\n    DragMovePrev,\n    /// Confirm the drop at the current drop target (fires `Props::on_reorder`).\n    Drop,\n    /// Cancel the active drag and discard the drop target.\n    CancelDrag,\n}\n\n/// Typed effect intents emitted by the `TreeView` machine. The agnostic core\n/// never touches the DOM; it emits these intents for adapters to resolve.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Effect {\n    /// Adapter scrolls the active-descendant node (`Context::focused_node`)\n    /// into view. }

320	
321	    fn transition(
322	        state: &Self::State,
323	        event: &Self::Event,
324	        ctx: &Self::Context,
325	        _props: &Self::Props,
326	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
327	        match event {
328	
329	            Event::ExpandNode(id) => {
330	                let id = id.clone();
331	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
332	                    let mut exp = ctx.expanded.get().clone();
333	                    exp.insert(id);
334	                    ctx.expanded.set(exp);
335	                }))
336	            }
337	
338	            Event::CollapseNode(id) => {
339	                let id = id.clone();
340	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
341	                    let mut exp = ctx.expanded.get().clone();
342	                    exp.remove(&id);
343	                    ctx.expanded.set(exp);
344	                }))
345	            }
346	
347	            Event::ToggleNode(id) => {
348	                let is_expanded = ctx.expanded.get().contains(id.as_str());
349	                let id = id.clone();
350	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
351	                    let mut exp = ctx.expanded.get().clone();
352	                    if is_expanded {
353	                        exp.remove(&id);
354	                    } else {
355	                        exp.insert(id);
356	                    }
357	                    ctx.expanded.set(exp);
358	                }))
359	            }
360	
361	            Event::SelectNode(id) => {
362	                if ctx.selection_mode == selection::Mode::None { return None; }
363	                let key = Key::from(id);
364	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
365	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.select(key);
366	                    ctx.selected.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
367	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
368	                }))
369	            }
370	
371	            Event::DeselectNode(id) => {
372	                let key = Key::from(id);
373	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
374	                    let new_state = ctx.selection_state.deselect(key);
375	                    ctx.selected.set(new_state.selected_keys.clone());
376	                    ctx.selection_state = new_state;
377	                }))
378	            }
379	
380	            Event::FocusNode(id) => {
381	                let id = id.clone();
382	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
383	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
384	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(id);
385	                    }))
386	            }
387	
388	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
389	                let is_keyboard = *is_keyboard;
390	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)
391	                    .apply(move |ctx| {
392	                        ctx.focus_visible = is_keyboard;
393	                    }))
394	            }
395	
396	            Event::Blur => {
397	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
398	                    .apply(|ctx| {
399	                        ctx.focus_visible = false;
400	                    }))
401	            }
402	
403	            // ── Navigation (via TreeCollection API) ────────────────────────
404	            Event::FocusNext => {
405	                // Use TreeCollection::key_after() which respects expanded state
406	                // and skips structural nodes. Wraps to first node.
407	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
408	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
409	                let target = match &ctx.focused_node {
410	                    Some(current) => {
411	                        let pos = visible.iter().position(|k| k == current);
412	                        pos.and_then(|p| visible.get(p + 1).or_else(|| visible.first()))
413	                    }
414	                    None => visible.first(),
415	                };
416	                target.map(|key| {
417	                    let k = key.clone();
418	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
419	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
420	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
421	                    })
422	                })
423	            }
424	
425	            Event::FocusPrev => {
426	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
427	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
428	                let target = match &ctx.focused_node {
429	                    Some(current) => {
430	                        let pos = visible.iter().position(|k| k == current);
431	                        pos.and_then(|p| {
432	                            if p > 0 { visible.get(p - 1) }
433	                            else { visible.last() }
434	                        })
435	                    }
436	                    None => visible.last(),
437	                };
438	                target.map(|key| {
439	                    let k = key.clone();
440	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
441	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
442	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
443	                    })
444	                })
445	            }
446	
447	            Event::FocusFirst => {
448	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
449	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
450	                visible.first().map(|key| {
451	                    let k = key.clone();
452	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
453	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
454	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
455	                    })
456	                })
457	            }
458	
459	            Event::FocusLast => {
460	                let expanded = ctx.expanded.get();
461	                let visible = ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(expanded);
462	                visible.last().map(|key| {
463	                    let k = key.clone();
464	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
465	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(k);
466	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
467	                    })
468	                })
469	            }
470	
471	            Event::FocusParent => {
472	                // Use Node::parent_key from the TreeCollection to navigate up
473	                let target = ctx.focused_node.as_ref()
474	                    .and_then(|focused| ctx.items.get(focused))
475	                    .and_then(|node| node.parent_key.clone());
476	                target.map(|key| {
477	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
478	                        ctx.focused_node = Some(key);
479	                        ctx.focus_visible = true;
480	                    })
481	                })
482	            }

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/task-267/spec/components/navigation/tree-view.md",
  "old_string": "    fn connect<'a>(\n        state: &'a Self::State,\n        ctx: &'a Self::Context,\n        props: &'a Self::Props,\n        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),\n    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {\n        Api { state, ctx, props, send }\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### 1.6 Connect / API",
  "new_string": "    fn connect<'a>(\n        state: &'a Self::State,\n        ctx: &'a Self::Context,\n        props: &'a Self::Props,\n        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),\n    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {\n        Api { state, ctx, props, send }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Direction shared by relative focus and keyboard drop-slot stepping.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy)]\nenum Direction { Next, Prev }\n\n/// Move the focus indicator to `key` and emit the scroll-into-view intent.\nfn focus_plan(key: Key) -> TransitionPlan<Machine> {\n    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused)\n        .apply(move |ctx| { ctx.focused_node = Some(key); ctx.focus_visible = true; })\n        .with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::ScrollFocusedIntoView))\n}\n\n/// Visible keys (DFS order) under the current expansion set.\nfn visible_keys(ctx: &Context) -> Vec<Key> {\n    ctx.items.visible_keys_with_expanded(ctx.expanded.get())\n}\n\n/// Relative focus target, wrapping at the ends.\nfn focus_relative(ctx: &Context, direction: Direction) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>> {\n    let visible = visible_keys(ctx);\n    if visible.is_empty() { return None; }\n    let target = match ctx.focused_node.as_ref()\n        .and_then(|current| visible.iter().position(|k| k == current))\n    {\n        Some(pos) => match direction {\n            Direction::Next => visible.get(pos + 1).or_else(|| visible.first()),\n            Direction::Prev => if pos > 0 { visible.get(pos - 1) } else { visible.last() },\n        },\n        None => match direction { Direction::Next => visible.first(), Direction::Prev => visible.last() },\n    };\n    target.cloned().map(focus_plan)\n}\n\n/// Next visible node whose label starts with `ch` (case-insensitive), after the\n/// focused node, wrapping around.\nfn typeahead_target(ctx: &Context, ch: char) -> Option<Key> {\n    let needle = ch.to_lowercase().next().unwrap_or(ch);\n    let visible = visible_keys(ctx);\n    if visible.is_empty() { return None; }\n    let start = ctx.focused_node.as_ref()\n        .and_then(|f| visible.iter().position(|k| k == f))\n        .map_or(0, |p| p + 1);\n    visible.iter().cycle().skip(start).take(visible.len())\n        .find(|key| ctx.items.get(key)\n            .and_then(|n| n.text_value.chars().next())\n            .map(|c| c.to_lowercase().next().unwrap_or(c)) == Some(needle))\n        .cloned()\n}\n\n/// Ordered valid keyboard drop slots for the dragged node: for every visible\n/// node that is neither the dragged node nor a descendant of it, three slots\n/// `Before`, `On`, `After`.\nfn valid_drop_slots(ctx: &Context, dragging: &Key) -> Vec<CollectionDropTarget> {\n    let mut slots = Vec::new();\n    for key in visible_keys(ctx) {\n        if &key == dragging || is_descendant(&ctx.items, dragging, &key) { continue; }\n        for position in [DropPosition::Before, DropPosition::On, DropPosition::After] {\n            slots.push(CollectionDropTarget { key: key.clone(), position });\n        }\n    }\n    slots\n}\n\n/// Step the keyboard drop target to the next/previous valid slot.\nfn drag_step(ctx: &Context, props: &Props, direction: Direction) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>> {\n    if !props.dnd_enabled { return None; }\n    let dragging = ctx.dragging.as_ref()?;\n    let slots = valid_drop_slots(ctx, dragging);\n    if slots.is_empty() { return None; }\n    let next = match ctx.drop_target.as_ref().and_then(|c| slots.iter().position(|s| s == c)) {\n        Some(pos) => match direction {\n            Direction::Next => (pos + 1) % slots.len(),\n            Direction::Prev => (pos + slots.len() - 1) % slots.len(),\n        },\n        None => match direction { Direction::Next => 0, Direction::Prev => slots.len() - 1 },\n    };\n    let target = slots[next].clone();\n    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| ctx.drop_target = Some(target)))\n}\n\n/// Whether `candidate` sits below `ancestor` in the tree.\nfn is_descendant(items: &TreeCollection<TreeItem>, ancestor: &Key, candidate: &Key) -> bool {\n    let mut current = items.get(candidate).and_then(|n| n.parent_key.clone());\n    while let Some(parent) = current {\n        if &parent == ancestor { return true; }\n        current = items.get(&parent).and_then(|n| n.parent_key.clone());\n    }\n    false\n}\n\n/// A drop is valid when it is not onto the dragged node or one of its\n/// descendants (which would create a cycle).\nfn is_valid_drop(items: &TreeCollection<TreeItem>, dragging: &Key, target: &CollectionDropTarget) -> bool {\n    &target.key != dragging && !is_descendant(items, dragging, &target.key)\n}\n\n/// Path of keys from the root down to `key` (inclusive).\nfn path_to(items: &TreeCollection<TreeItem>, key: &Key) -> Vec<Key> {\n    let mut path = Vec::new();\n    let mut current = Some(key.clone());\n    while let Some(node_key) = current {\n        current = items.get(&node_key).and_then(|n| n.parent_key.clone());\n        path.push(node_key);\n    }\n    path.reverse();\n    path\n}\n\n/// Named reorder effect that invokes `Props::on_reorder`.\nfn reorder_effect(event: ReorderEvent) -> PendingEffect<Machine> {\n    PendingEffect::new(Effect::Reorder, move |_ctx: &Context, props: &Props, _send| {\n        if let Some(callback) = &props.on_reorder { callback(event.clone()); }\n        no_cleanup()\n    })\n}\n```\n\n### 1.6 Connect / API"

602	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
603	#[scope = "tree-view"]
604	pub enum Part {
605	    Root,
606	    Branch { node_id: String },
607	    BranchControl { node_id: String },
608	    BranchIndicator { node_id: String },
609	    BranchText,
610	    BranchContent { node_id: String },
611	    Leaf { node_id: String },
612	    LeafText,
613	}

615	/// API for the `TreeView` component.
616	pub struct Api<'a> {
617	    /// Current machine state.
618	    state: &'a State,
619	    /// Current context.
620	    ctx:   &'a Context,
621	    /// Current props.
622	    props: &'a Props,
623	    /// Event dispatcher.
624	    send:  &'a dyn Fn(Event),
625	}
626	
627	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
628	    /// Check if a node is selected.
629	    pub fn is_node_selected(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
630	        self.ctx.selected.get().contains(&Key::from(id))
631	    }
632	
633	    /// Check if a node is expanded.
634	    pub fn is_node_expanded(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
635	        self.ctx.expanded.get().contains(id)
636	    }
637	
638	    /// Check if a node is focused.
639	    pub fn is_node_focused(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
640	        self.ctx.focused_node.as_ref().map(|k| k.as_ref()) == Some(id)
641	    }
642	
643	    /// Look up a node from the collection by key.
644	    pub fn get_node(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&ars_collections::Node<TreeItem>> {
645	        self.ctx.items.get(&Key::from(id))
646	    }
647	
648	    /// Compute (setsize, posinset) for a node from the collection.
649	    /// Returns (sibling count at this level, 1-based position among siblings).
650	    pub fn sibling_info(&self, id: &str) -> (u32, u32) {
651	        let key = Key::from(id);
652	        let node = match self.ctx.items.get(&key) { Some(n) => n, None => return (1, 1) };
653	        let siblings: Vec<_> = match &node.parent_key {
654	            Some(parent) => self.ctx.items.children_of(parent).collect(),
655	            None => {
656	                // Root-level nodes: collect all level-0 nodes
657	                self.ctx.items.nodes()
658	                    .filter(|n| n.parent_key.is_none())
659	                    .collect()
660	            }
661	        };
662	        let setsize = siblings.len() as u32;
663	        let posinset = siblings.iter()
664	            .position(|n| n.key == key)
665	            .map(|p| p as u32 + 1)
666	            .unwrap_or(1);
667	        (setsize, posinset)
668	    }

671	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
672	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();

697	    /// Attrs for a branch node (expandable, has children).
698	    ///
699	    /// `node_id` — unique ID. Level, setsize, posinset, and disabled state
700	    /// are derived from the `TreeCollection`.
701	    ///
702	    /// When the node's `has_children` flag is true, `aria-expanded` is always
703	    /// emitted even if the collection currently contains no children for this
704	    /// node. This is essential for lazy-loaded trees where the expand affordance
705	    /// must be present before children are fetched.
706	    pub fn branch_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
707	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
708	        let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);
709	        let is_selected = self.is_node_selected(node_id);
710	        let is_focused  = self.is_node_focused(node_id);
711	        let node = self.get_node(node_id);
712	        let level = node.map(|n| n.level as u32 + 1).unwrap_or(1); // 1-based
713	        let (setsize, posinset) = self.sibling_info(node_id);
714	        let disabled = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.disabled).unwrap_or(false);
715	        let has_children_flag = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.has_children).unwrap_or(false);
716	        let has_actual_children = node.map(|n| n.has_children).unwrap_or(false);
717	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "treeitem");
718	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Branch { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
719	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
720	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
721	        // Emit aria-expanded when the node has real children OR has_children flag is set
722	        if has_actual_children || has_children_flag {
723	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded), if is_expanded { "true" } else { "false" });
724	        }
725	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Selected), if is_selected { "true" } else { "false" });
726	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Level),   level.to_string());
727	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::SetSize), setsize.to_string());
728	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::PosInSet),posinset.to_string());
729	        if disabled { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true"); attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true); }
730	        if is_selected { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-selected"), true); }
731	        if is_expanded { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-expanded"), true); }
732	        if is_focused && self.ctx.focus_visible { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true); }
733	        attrs
734	    }
735	
736	    /// Attrs for the clickable control area inside a branch (the row the user activates).
737	    /// When the node has an `href`, sets `HtmlAttr::Href` so the adapter renders an `<a>`
738	    /// element instead of a `<div>`. The `role="treeitem"` on the parent `Branch` is preserved.
739	    pub fn branch_control_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
740	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
741	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchControl { node_id: String::new() }.data_attrs();
742	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
743	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
744	        if let Some(href) = self.get_node(node_id)
745	            .and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref())
746	            .and_then(|v| v.href.as_deref())
747	        {
748	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Href, href);
749	        }
750	        attrs
751	    }

755	        (self.send)(Event::ToggleNode(node_id.to_string()));
756	        (self.send)(Event::FocusNode(node_id.to_string()));
757	    }

786	    /// Attrs for the children container inside an expanded branch (`role="group"`).
787	    pub fn branch_content_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
788	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
789	        let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);
790	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "group");
791	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchContent { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
792	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);

800	    /// Attrs for a leaf node (no children, no expand/collapse).
801	    /// Level, setsize, posinset, and disabled state are derived from the `TreeCollection`.
802	    ///
803	    /// When the node's `has_children` flag is true (but no actual children are
804	    /// loaded), the leaf is treated as an expandable node: `aria-expanded="false"`
805	    /// is set so screen readers announce the expand affordance. Once children
806	    /// are loaded, the node transitions from `Leaf` to `Branch` in the adapter.
807	    ///
808	    /// When the node has an `href`, sets `HtmlAttr::Href` so the adapter renders
809	    /// an `<a>` element instead of the default element. `role="treeitem"` is preserved.
810	    pub fn leaf_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {
811	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
812	        let is_selected = self.is_node_selected(node_id);
813	        let is_focused  = self.is_node_focused(node_id);
814	        let node = self.get_node(node_id);
815	        let level = node.map(|n| n.level as u32 + 1).unwrap_or(1);
816	        let (setsize, posinset) = self.sibling_info(node_id);
817	        let disabled = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.disabled).unwrap_or(false);
818	        let has_children_flag = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref()).map(|v| v.has_children).unwrap_or(false);
819	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "treeitem");
820	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Leaf { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();
821	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
822	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
823	        // When has_children is true but no children are loaded yet, show expand affordance
824	        if has_children_flag {
825	            let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);
826	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded), if is_expanded { "true" } else { "false" });
827	        }
828	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Selected), if is_selected { "true" } else { "false" });
829	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Level),    level.to_string());
830	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::SetSize),  setsize.to_string());
831	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::PosInSet), posinset.to_string());
832	        if disabled { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true"); attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true); }
833	        if is_selected { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-selected"), true); }
834	        if is_focused && self.ctx.focus_visible { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true); }
835	        // When href is present, the adapter renders this as an <a> element
836	        if let Some(href) = node
837	            .and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref())
838	            .and_then(|v| v.href.as_deref())
839	        {
840	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Href, href);
841	        }
842	        attrs
843	    }

The `role=\"treeitem\"` on the parent `Branch` is preserved.\n    pub fn branch_control_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchControl { node_id: String::new() }.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        if let Some(href) = self.get_node(node_id)\n            .and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref())\n            .and_then(|v| v.href.as_deref())\n        {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Href, href);\n        }\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Handle click event for the branch control.\n    pub fn on_branch_control_click(&self, node_id: &str) {\n        (self.send)(Event::ToggleNode(node_id.to_string()));\n        (self.send)(Event::FocusNode(node_id.to_string()));\n    }\n\n    /// Attrs for the expand/collapse chevron indicator inside a branch.\n    pub fn branch_indicator_attrs(&self, node_id: &str) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::BranchIndicator { node_id: Default::default() }.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        if is_expanded { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-expanded\"), true);   "new_string": "#[derive(ComponentPart)]\n#[scope = \"tree-view\"]\npub enum Part {\n    Root,\n    Branch { node_id: Key },\n    BranchControl { node_id: Key },\n    BranchIndicator { node_id: Key },\n    BranchText,\n    BranchContent { node_id: Key },\n    Leaf { node_id: Key },\n    LeafText,\n    /// Optional drag handle affordance for a draggable node (§4).\n    DragHandle { node_id: Key },\n    /// Visual indicator showing where a dragged node will be dropped (§4).\n    DropIndicator,\n}\n\n/// API for the `TreeView` component. Node identity is `Key`. Branch/leaf\n/// elements carry a stable `id` (via [`node_dom_id`]) so the root's\n/// `aria-activedescendant` can reference the focused node.\npub struct Api<'a> {\n    state: &'a State,\n    ctx:   &'a Context,\n    props: &'a Props,\n    send:  &'a dyn Fn(Event),\n}\n\nimpl Api<'_> {\n    /// Whether a node is selected.\n    pub fn is_node_selected(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.selected.get().contains(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Whether a node is expanded.\n    pub fn is_node_expanded(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.expanded.get().contains(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Whether a node holds the focus indicator.\n    pub fn is_node_focused(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.focused_node.as_ref() == Some(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Whether a node is currently being dragged.\n    pub fn is_dragging(&self, node_id: &Key) -> bool {\n        self.ctx.dragging.as_ref() == Some(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// The current resolved drop target during an active drag, if any.\n    pub const fn drop_target(&self) -> Option<&CollectionDropTarget> {\n        self.ctx.drop_target.as_ref()\n    }\n\n    /// Look up a node from the collection by key.\n    pub fn get_node(&self, node_id: &Key) -> Option<&Node<TreeItem>> {\n        self.ctx.items.get(node_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Compute `(setsize, posinset)` — sibling count at this level and 1-based\n    /// position among siblings.\n    pub fn sibling_info(&self, node_id: &Key) -> (u32, u32) {\n        let Some(node) = self.ctx.items.get(node_id) else { return (1, 1); };\n        let siblings = match &node.parent_key {\n            Some(parent) => self.ctx.items.children_of(parent).collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n            None => self.ctx.items.all_nodes().filter(|n| n.parent_key.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        };\n        let setsize = siblings.len() as u32;\n        let posinset = siblings.iter().position(|n| n.key == *node_id).map_or(1, |p| p as u32 + 1);\n        (setsize, posinset)\n    }\n\n    /// Loading indicator text for a branch whose children are being fetched.\n    pub fn loading_label(&self) -> String {\n        (self.ctx.messages.loading_label)(&self.ctx.locale)\n    }\n\n    /// Attrs for the tree root container (`role=\"tree\"`). Uses the\n    /// active-descendant pattern: `tabindex=\"0\"` plus `aria-activedescendant`\n    /// pointing at the focused node's stable id.\n    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = part_only_attrs(&Part::Root);\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"tree\");\n        if self.ctx.multiple {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::MultiSelectable), \"true\");\n        }\n        if let Some(focused) = &self.ctx.focused_node {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ActiveDescendant), node_dom_id(&self.ctx.ids, focused));\n        }\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, \"0\");\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Handle focus on the tree root.\n    pub fn on_root_focus(&self) { (self.send)(Event::Focus { is_keyboard: false }); }\n\n    /// Handle blur on the tree root.\n    pub fn on_root_blur(&self) { (self.send)(Event::Blur); }\n\n    /// Attrs for a branch node. `aria-expanded` is emitted when the node has\n    /// real children OR its `has_children` flag is set (lazy branches).\n    pub fn branch_attrs(&self, node_id: &Key) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = part_only_attrs(&Part::Branch { node_id: Key::default() });\n        let node = self.ctx.items.get(node_id);\n        let is_expanded = self.is_node_expanded(node_id);\n        let is_selected = self.is_node_selected(node_id);\n        let is_focused  = self.is_node_focused(node_id);\n        let level = node.map_or(1, |n| n.level as u32 + 1);\n        let (setsize, posinset) = self.sibling_info(node_id);\n        let item = node.and_then(|n| n.value.as_ref());\n        let disabled = item.is_some_and(|v| v.disabled);\n        let has_children_flag = item.is_some_and(|v| v.has_children);\n        let has_actual_children = node.is_some_and(|n| n.has_children);\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, node_dom_id(&self.ctx.ids, node_id));\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"treeitem\");\n        if has_actual_children || has_children_flag {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Expanded), bool_token(is_expanded));\n        }\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Selected), bool_token(is_selected));\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Level), level.to_string());\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::SetSize), setsize.to_string());\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::PosInSet), posinset.to_string());\n        self.apply_node_state(&mut attrs, disabled, is_selected, is_expanded, is_focused, node_id);\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attrs for the clickable control row inside a branch (`<a>` when href).\n    pub fn branch_control_attrs(&self, node_id: &Key) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = part_only_attrs(&Part::BranchControl { node_id: Key::default() });\n        if let Some(href) = self.node_href(node_id) { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Href, href); }\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Handle activation of a branch control: toggle expansion and focus.\n    pub fn on_branch_control_click(&self, node_id: &Key) {\n        (self.send)(Event::ToggleNode(node_id.clone()));\n        (self.send)(Event::FocusNode(node_id.clone()));\n    }\n\n    /// Attrs for the expand/collapse chevron indicator inside a branch.\n    pub fn branch_indicator_attrs(&self, node_id: &Key) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = part_only_attrs(&Part::BranchIndicator { node_id:
